title: Magic 5 S1-S4
description: The five teenagers, namely Naura, Rahsya, Adara, Gibran, and Irshad are chosen children who get different superpowers. They were adopted by Fathir, a rich man who lives alone. They became teenagers and formed a group called Magic 5. They face various challenges and dangers around them and live normal lives like humans in general. They have to deal with popular school gangs, namely "The Beast", "The Hebrings", "The Handsome 4", "The Gorgeous 3". Often facing problems at school, and also involved in various cases in society that require their powers. His Strongest Enemy has power and he wants to target Magic 5 because only they have enough energy to be used as a source of his power. But he can't just steal the power of Magic 5 because he can't just take their power, only that person can take their power sincerely.

description: A group of college alumni in their 30's gather at one of their friend's second wedding. The members composed of mainly men had one woman who they were anticipating to see at the wedding. However, the woman's daughter come to the wedding on behalf of her dead mother and was in fact looking for her dad who was actually at the reception.

description: A pressured accountant, his war veteran brother and their dysfunctional family struggle with integrating into post-War Korean society.

title: Döden, Döden, Döden
description: Anna Lindman tries to get to know man's greatest fear and seeks answers to questions about death that we ask.

title: Boys Feels: Desire in the Dark
description: These five award-winning coming of age short films offer a glimpse of how boys and young men tackle life's difficult desires: confronting one's demons, understanding sexual relationships, gaining the respect of one's father, or simply running away from it all. This is only the start of their complex formative years, where not every question has an answer, and not every answer makes sense.

title: Creepy AF
description: When a creepy teen from a family of infamous serial killers becomes a viral heartthrob after rescuing a social media star, he must juggle his newfound romance with his family's demand that he commit his first murder.

title: Ripa Hits the Skids
description: A week-long glimpse into the wretched existence of Ripa, a long-haired, hard-drinking lug. He is also a wannabe filmmaker whose last two projects were condemned for their sex and violence. A Parasite Deluxe who barely recalls his previous night, Ripa cruises the bars and meets bank-teller Tiina.

title: Prisma: Illustrerad konst- och kulturrevy
description: "Prisma: illustrated art and cultural revue" - about current events, trends and notable people in the world of artistic culture.

title: Sommarkollo
description: Sommarkollo is a web and TV drama series for 8-12 year olds where we follow five 12-year old kids during a weeklong summer camp. A Scandinavian summer filled with drama, love, disappointments, friends and adventure.
A weekly news and current event program with in-depth reports and conversations.

title: Tilde
description: Tilde is a live interview program from Junibacken's terrace on Djurgården in the middle of Stockholm's inner city.

title: Lain mukaan
description: About a woman who out of greed and vanity sells herself to a rich squire.

title: Flickorna på Solvik
description: In the Skåne manor house Cronoholm, the rich Baron Rutger Cronsköld live with his two children Börje and Martha.

title: Matters of the Heart
description: Follows a middle-class family who, on the surface, have a happy and perfect life. But behind the facade, the family is on the verge of disintegration due to the father's escalating alcohol consumption.

title: Vain kaksi tuntia
description: Jännitysdraama pikkukaupungin sairaalasta jossa syyllisyyden ja mustasukkaisuuden riivaama ylilääkäri turvautuu äärimmäiseen ratkaisuun.

title: Verden er fuld af børn
description: A young couple wants to have children but cannot have them. When it turns out that it is due to the man's sterility, a crisis arises in the relationship.

title: Dirty Fingers
description: A young woman dies from a drug overdose, and her brother and his friend try to find out who supplied her with the narcotics. Soon, they're chased all over Stockholm by the cruel but suave ring leader Harry and his thugs. Among the wildness is a fight in a brothel filled with naked girls, and when Servus, one of the thugs, fails to kill our heroes, Harry has his men kill Servus with a razor blade equipped glove. Oh, and the heroine is raped by a guy sucking on a comforter.

title: Return of the Witch
description: Archaeological team unearths a body of a young woman, who was told to be a witch buried in the bog some 300 years ago. Soon a naked woman appears and drives the men of the village crazy. Everybody is certain that this really is the witch killed in days of yore. At the end the wild happenings during those few days appeared to be a dream of the professor leading the excavations.

title: Ud af mørket
description: A couple of reckless decisions lead to fatal consequences for four young friends. Johnny and Milla are a young couple whose safe every day life takes an unexpected turn when Johnny's old childhood friend, Nino, suddenly makes contact. Nino's younger brother Miki, has a huge debt to settle and needs to come up with 850.000 dkk (about $160,000) by midnight- the same night. Due to Nino's impulsive cash-fueled decisions, the three friends hunt for money leads them deep inside the dirty underworld of Copenhagen and within a short time; they find themselves hunted throughout the streets. In one night - loyalty, love and friendship are put to the test.

title: Hallin Janne
description: 1800-luvun lopulla Längelmäellä tehtiin raaka veriteko jossa kaksi miestä tappoi postelijoonin ja ryösti postilaukun rahat. Perustuu tositapahtumiin.

title: Brottmålsdomaren
description: Criminal judge Evald Sterner and engineer Kai Falk are rivals of the beautiful Jesta Fridman, daughter of the rich banker.

title: Sockerexperimentet
description: The film is inspired by a controversial experiment that took place in Sweden in 1948.

title: The Girl from the Third Row
description: Is man's existence really meaningful and hopeful? As a reply to Ingmar Bergman's Prison (1949), this movie claims that it is. A ring passes between a lot of different people, giving the bearer or someone close a new meaning to life. Actors, embezzlers, old ladies, and cheated husbands all seem to gain temporary hope from misery and disillusionment.

title: Ministerpresidenten
description: Newspaper man Jean Bazard and Lawyer Alphonse Carrel are rivals of the beautiful Rose Legrange.

title: Série - Impact S1-S2
description:
Créer des émotions fortes et de qualité et les rendre accessibles à tous les consommateurs du Sénégal et d’Afrique, tel est l’engagement de Marodi TV.
S’inspirer des émotions des différentes couches de la population pour créer des opportunités de visibilité et d’engagement pour les marques, telle est l’opportunité qu’offre Marodi TV.

title: Heartbeats
description: "Encounter". Seven stories of women. Occasionally intersecting with each other in everyday situations. Parallel episodes of hope and abandonment, addiction and infidelity, but also friendship and trust.

title: Kärleken segrar
description: Farm girl Olga Ström is seduced by the Hans Brandt, who soon abandons her, even though she carries their child.

title: Holy Mess
description: A gay couple invites their somewhat-homophobic families to meet for the first time during Christmastime, and they have a special gift for them.

title: Pikajuna pohjoiseen
description: The destinies of different kind of people encounter in a passenger train that is traveling from Helsinki to the Norht.

title: Mauro & Pluras kök
description: Mauro & Pluras kök

title: Kapitler af Danmarks historie
description: Over five seasons, historians Palle Lauring and Erik Kjersgaard delve into significant chapters from the history of Denmark.

title: Senandung Si Dayang
description: Princess Aqilah was hated by the people for being ugly, but she was not accepted by her in-laws. The series began with ancient times, where focused on Megasari's character, Elly Mazlein's lively black girl who loved the king in silence. He is the son of a witch and is often insulted by the king. When Megasari died, his father swore all the princesses of the king's descendants worse than Megasari. The curse became when the Queen gave birth to a black baby girl and named Dayang Senandung (Azza AF1 played). After marrying the king's son, the curse continued until the birth of Princess Aqilah.

title: Snowroller - Sällskapsresan II
description: Stig Helmer takes another vacation with his Norwegian friend Ole, this time a skiing vacation in the Alps. Of course, Stig has never learned downhill skiing, but he attends a ski school. The two men also manage to charm two women who are also vacationing. The other Swedish tourists are a diverse group that includes the choleric Mr. Jönsson and his family, and two men trying to sell kick-sleds.

title: Jill and Joy's Winter
description: Jill and Joy (both 9) live in their own house like any other little girls, except that they might be a little happier than most little girls, as they get to live in their own house specifically designed for the two. One December evening a small car, barely the size of a shoebox, pulls up in front their house, and a teensy-weensy family gets out: the McTiny family. The family has become homeless after a road-roller smashed their home. Planning to live with the girls temporarily, the family moves in with Jill and Joy but soon finds out that not all big people have good intentions towards them.

title: Måndagsbörsen
description: Live music from the Hamburger Börs in Stockholm.

title: Swoon
description: A sensational story of forbidden love, a rivalry between two families and a war between two amusement parks. A magic story based on the real history of Gröna Lund, an actual amusement park in Stockholm - the capital of Sweden.

title: 92 minutter af i går
description: A French businessman meets a Danish girl in Copenhagen. The two feel attracted to each other, but the girl does not understand French and the man does not understand Danish.

title: Creepy AF
description: An online paranormal series from horror director Ace Jordan. Hosted by Erik Vanlier, special guest investigator on Ghost Adventures, Good Mythical Morning and more!

title: Lyckligare kan ingen vara
description: The story revolve around five couples of different generations. Their lives are woven together by coincidences but sometimes through very deliberate choices where the common driving force is the search for love.

title: c/o Segemyhr
description: Four people living together in an apartment can give rise to a lot of funny situations, especially if they are as different as these four: Fredrik is the nominal apartment owner, a bit superior to the others, currently "between two jobs". His girlfriend Cilla would prefer that they lived there alone, without Fredrik's crude brother Jan-Olof or the young cab driver Anton.

title: Det var en gång en sjöman
description: Shipmate Öman comes to the north-African city of Jazzablanca, a nest of sin with prostitution and organized crime.

title: Vi två
description: Widower Robert Rossiter lives in New York with his two teenage children. When he visits a fashion house one day, he falls in love with the store clerk Joyce Roamer.

title: DI4RIES S1-S2
description: First crushes, first kisses, beautiful friendships - and quarrels between rivals. At the Galileo Galilei middle school, days go by among a thousand surprises.

title: Afsane-ye-ah
description: "The Legend of A Sigh" is a fantastical story which explores the hardships and strengths of women in Iran. Based on the mythology of Azerbaijan, it begins when a woman accidentally summons a mystical being with the power of her sigh. The being then shows her the lives of four women from different social backgrounds, each of whom are far worse off than her but remain strong nonetheless. Can she draw strength from their stories, and be healed by the magical being inside the sigh? An almost Dickensian tale of magic and strength in the face of adversity.

title: Ah Beng the Movie: 3 Wishes
description: It's the eve of The Lunar New Year in a village. Every household is busy preparing to receive the auspicious God Of Fortune (GOF). Comes midnight, people of various races impersonate the GOF. They walk up to each household to offer mandarin oranges and lucky numbers in return for an "Ang Pau". Ah Beng's father being poor, dishes out only coins to these GOF. The worst dressed scruffy GOF who receives a tiny token from Ah Beng's father, is in fact, the true and almighty GOF. Without realizing, Ah Beng's father comments that he should be better dressed and wishes him good luck and good health, very sincerely. The true GOF is surprised but touched by Ah Beng's father's sincerity and grants him 3 wishes. Not-so-bright security guard Ah Beng works at an open car-park, is being bullied by a group of rich brats with luxury cars, over their parking fee. A mysterious guy comes in and helps Ah Beng. Grateful for his help, Ah Beng invites him into his life and things starts to change around him. One day at work, Bobby is injured while filming and with the help of Ah Beng, Rain and the mysterious guy, Bobby is brought to the hospital where they see both Ah Lian and Salted Fish Lian. Salted Fish Lian was collecting her medicine from the pharmacy. Ah Beng and the gang secretly investigates Salted Fish Lian's condition and is shocked to find out that Salted Fish Lian is very sick. Back home, Ah Beng and the gang, are thinking of ways to save Salted Fish Lian. Bobby then spots a Talent Search contest in a newspaper with a massive grand prize of cash. Rain, Bobby and Ah Beng quickly form a singing trio to join the contest. Do they win? Who is the Mysterious Guy? Why is he there?

title: Above the Line
description: Hosts AJ Mandeville and Ryan Wydeveld take you on a fun-filled trip through Indywood, the bustling world of independent film thriving in Northern California. Above the Line features segments like "Pints and the Pipeline", where our hosts get to know up-and-coming projects and talent over an ice cold pint of locally brewed beer; "Martini Shots", where we enjoy a hand-crafted martini with Producers and Directors as their projects wrap; "Chewing the Scene", in which we sit down one-on-one with actors to discuss especially powerful or talented scenes and their process of bringing them to life; and "All Set Up", a DIY series about the secrets of movie magic.

title: Nona
description: Stephen King's popular short horror story comes to life on the screen. A young man in prison recounts the events that have led him there. He tells the story of how he met and fell in love with a beautiful girl named Nona. The loving couple sets out on a journey where they encounter many different characters. While encountering these new characters, the man is changed by Nona's mysterious seduction and starts to slowly slip into madness. The adventure is filled with unexpected twists and turns until the very last second. The journey starts to comes to a close near Stephen King's fictional town of Castle Rock when Nona lures the narrator to a graveyard. There she asks her repeated question 'Do you love?'. It is up to the audience to decipher whether or not Nona was a figment of insanity or was actually a real person. The movie ends with a true question being asked, "How far would you go for love?"

title: The Devil's Bargain
description: It's 1974. Earth is about to be obliterated by a massive asteroid. Adi (Jonnie Hurn) and his young hippy wife Ange (Chloe Farnworth), haunted by memories of the death of their child a few years earlier, journey to the idyllic rural setting where he was conceived, determined to make peace with the world and each other before the planet is destroyed forever. Adi's overly pragmatic view of life and 'what comes afterwards' (or doesn't) begins to grate with the free-spirited Ange. She seduces the reluctant Adi into reliving happier times, and for a moment it seems as if this troubled couple may actually find peace at the end. But the arrival of Luca (Dan Burman), a charismatic and mysterious young photographer, turns what's left of the world upside-down. Despite Adi's aggressive reaction to Luca taking photos of him and his wife naked, Luca manages to persuade the couple to allow him to ride out the end of days with them. It soon becomes clear that Ange wants to enjoy the company of both men and that Luca's arrival on the scene may not have been entirely accidental. But there is more at work here than free love and cuckolding. Luca is clearly a man of power, and as the asteroid careens closer to the earth the tensions rise between the three, and what could have been a peaceful swansong for Adi becomes a litany of revelations, personal and biblical, a psychological nightmare, and a hellish final judgment.

On the way down, Mackenzie is sullen and irritable because she has to spend her Christmas away from the city (Atlanta) with relatives she doesn't like in a town she is not fond of. Upon arrival to Sally's house, Sally's 8 year old son Tyler (Luke Westerfield) excitedly talks to Mackenzie about Christmas and the Preceding week's Duck Days festivities which Ash reveals is a big tradition in this tiny town. While celebrating the festivities and shopping for Christmas gifts, Mackenzie and Tyler go to see Santa. He is not at his post, but the two teens run into him in the local café. title: Al-fahd
description: The struggle of an ordinary peasant against the feudal system and the authorities.

title: Al Zawga Al Oula
description: Dr. Rima's family life is turned upside down after learning about her husband Akram's affair with Karen, and events escalate over time.

title: Al-suq al-Soda'
description: A corrupt grocer in a traditional Cairene neighborhood enters into an alliance with comprador merchants. Their goal is to hoard scarce commodities during the World WAR II, and then to sell them at vastly inflated prices. Eventually the grocer's neighbors rebel at his tactics. They call in the national athorities and the black marketeers are brought to justice.

title: Al Mahmeyah
description: Farah and Hamza live in an area called Al Mahmeyah, which is exposed one day to great danger by a group of sharks, so they try to confront them and save the residents and animals.

title: Al Sajeen Al Nsaab
description: A highly intelligent fraudster, who possesses many skills in scamming his victims of celebrities and businessmen, succeeds in forming a team to help him in the fraud operations, so the police forces seek the help of university professor Dr. Shamlan to help them catch him.

title: Fursan Al Zalam: Zhiaab Al Layl
description: In a city besieged by forces of evil, love blossoms between Salma and Zaid, but things take a turn when Abu Al Dahma forcibly marries her, and Zaid sets out to take revenge on him, especially after Abu Al Dahma wreaks havoc in the city along with the chief guard Abu Al Dawrak and the sorcerer Abu Al Hakam.

title: Al-Azwag Al-Shayateen
description: Mamdooh, Kamel and Fathi are three friends who work in one company. Kamel and Fathi are married while Mamdooh is a single person who rents a float for his pleasures. Kamel and Fathi visit him escaping from their wives. Naimah steels the jewelry of her employer, who chases her. She runs away by riding in Mamdooh's car. Mamdooh takes Naimah to the float, hoping to spend a good time with her. His friends Kamel and Fathi come to share in the fun, but the police came and captured everyone after Naimah hidden the stolen jewelry in the float's sofa. Naimah was detained and the three young men were released. Mamdooh visits his friend Kamel at home and saw Magdah, his sister-in-law, and marries her. Naimah comes out of prison and chases the couples until she reaches the float and recovers the stolen goods. But the wives arrive with the police who arrest Naimah and get the stolen jewelry. The husbands were released but were chased by the wives.

title: Al Aliya
description: Set in Al Aliya, a rural village in Yemen; the plot reviews social relations, power struggles, and love relationships that are subject to strict customs and traditions and conflicting interests that threaten their continuity.

title: Al-Rakib Al-Khaled
description: After he completed his mandatory military service, the filmmaker was held in retention as the revolution unfurled in his country. His military rank was that of a sergeant. During these times, he would go back to his home, located in the middle of Damascus city, take off his military uniform and return to his normal life, working as an assistant director with the filmmaker Mohammed Malas. To make sense of this schizophrenic situation, he decides to take his camera and start shooting a 'making-of' that will eventually go beyond Malas' film.

title: Al Makida
description: Khaled, a man in his sixties, was murdered in mysterious circumstances and the killer remains unidentified. Several unsolved crimes have been committed in the same house until the police devise a plan to capture the real killer.

title: Al Saf Al Akheer
description: A young man who has little experience with life and looks at everything around him from one angle, embarks on a journey from one day that turns all his concepts upside down.

title: Rechazando al Fénix, Domando al Dragón
description: Samara, marcada por una mancha de nacimiento y una rivalidad constante con su hermana Sienna, sufre traición y manipulación. En un mundo donde los vínculos entre humanos y bestias son vitales, Samara forma un vínculo con el dragón Alaric, lo que cura su maldición. Descubre su propia fuerza, expone el engaño de Sienna y encuentra la aceptación a través de la transformación y su nuevo vínculo con Alaric.

title: Al Basha
description: The events revolve around the officer Hossam, who works in the Department of Combating Morals, and in one of his missions he discovers that there is a prostitution network run by a businessman who succeeds every time using his influence and authority to get out of any charges against him, which leads to Hossam's failure in his mission to escalate the events.

title: Al Fin y Al Cabo
description: Two FBI agents arrive to the Dominican Republic to come after a drug lord called "El Duque". Local policeman Cabo Azulado and petty thief Joe help them with their investigation.

title: Al Armala W Al Shaytan
description: A wealthy widow accused of killing her husband for his money and Gad a Lebanese man who returned from Canada. After they get married, he runs her business but the widow goes through a psychological conflict with a two-faced husband.

title: Al-Fetewa
description: In the world of local neighborhoods, a sect of strong people come together to manage the affairs of these neighborhoods. Known as Al-Fetewa, they are ruffians who shoulder the responsibility of the people in their neighborhoods.

title: Al-azraa wa al shaar al abyad
description: After a woman loses hope of bearing a child of her own, she adopts an orphan against her husband's will, but when the child becomes a young woman, she falls in love with her adoptive father.

title: Al Sigil Al Aswad
description: A love story arises between a young man and a girl, however, the boy is exposed to many psychological problems due to the magic carried out by a charlatan to destroy his life.

title: Al Dahik Al Baki

title: Hug an Atheist
description: Hug an Atheist is built around a series of interviews conducted in 2012-2013 and led by Sylvia Broeckx. From its crowd-funded beginning, the film's objective has been to dispel many of the stubborn and long-standing myths and untruths that plague this group of people. A University of Minnesota survey from 2006 showed atheists to be the most distrusted group within the American population, yet whenever someone was pressed to explain their opinion they reached for myths and platitudes. The film tries to illustrate how this group's attitude towards life is really not all that different from most religious people. By interviewing ordinary American atheists, Hug an Atheist takes the viewer on an emotional roller coaster highlighting love, grief, morals, parenting and other life-defining moments and ideas and how and how each is dealt with in a life undefined by a God, religion or afterlife. Apart from these interviews, the filmmakers had unique access to key moments in the lives of some of the protagonists, from a humanist wedding to an atheist Christmas. Scholars and atheist activists provide the broader intellectual and social context in which to place these regular people and their ideas and approaches to life. Is an atheist's morality and sense of good and bad always indebted to the religious context that surrounds them? Is it even possible to define morals and ethics without a 'super-being' or afterlife? Do atheists really wage a war on Christmas? From the academic to the more mundane, Hug an Atheist answers questions that are being asked or should be asked by anyone uninformed or misinformed this growing US minority. The featured atheists span the US geography; filming was conducted from New York to San Francisco, from Harvard to Kentucky, and culminated at the 2013 annual convention of American Atheists in Austin, Texas. These people represent a cross-section of the population, from academics to a comedian, store owners to teachers: American atheists are part of everyday society.

title: An Inspector Calls
description: A mysterious inspector investigates the wealthy Birling family and their dinner guest following the suicide of a young woman.

title: An Unusual Summer
description: The images contain their chronology, down to the minutes and seconds: In 2006, a surveillance camera in the Arab quarter of Ramla films a car that a short while ago became the victim of vandalism. Neighbours and passersby walk past it as if nothing has happened. Do they have something to hide? Then someone puts his hand on the trunk - An absurdly patient everyday thriller that doubles as an experimental film. Images that change according to the weather become almost indecipherable at night. The device performs its function only half-heartedly. Kamal Aljafari scans its grainy recordings for traces of his late father, who years ago attached the camera to the wall. A search for life and death becomes both a game and a sincere study of what holds the world together.

title: An Ungodly Tie
description: God calls us to love Him with all our soul. Yet we can be enticed away from God by those that are "as our own soul" and compromise our full devotion to our Heavenly Father. Such relationships form the foundation for ungodly soul ties. If we are not careful with the soul ties we form, we may even compromise our immortal souls.

title: An English Gentleman
description: Thomas Ravenwood tries to regain his honour as a man and as a husband. Inspired by Thomas Gainsborough's 1793 painting 'Mrs.Siddons'.

title: An Easter Bloom
description: A young gardener sets out to save her family farm by entering a floral competition for Easter. She meets a local pastor along the way who helps her restore the hope she lost.

title: An Ordinary Country
description: Controlled conversations, recording with hidden cameras, dirty records of interrogations and recruitment attempts as well as video tutorials for the officers of the security service - all of these materials are employed to portray the monitored life in Poland under communism. Sometimes grotesque, this picture is underpinned by horror, escalating intuitively with every minute. The dramatic culmination is when the Big Brother is not just watching but violating the intimacy of an ordinary citizen. Before us, there is a terrifying communist panopticon which keeps spying on and recording itself.

title: I Married an Actress
description: An actor is jealous of his wife's stardom.

title: An Alligator Named Daisy
description: An Englishman is left with an abandoned, very tame, and domesticated pet alligator, who helps him develop a bond with a young Irishwoman. Plans to get rid of the animal cause mayhem and produce a surprising outcome for all.

title: Destinada ao Meu Vizinho Chefe
description: Após uma noite com Élio, Sheila dá à luz gêmeos. Catarina, sua malvada meia-irmã, rouba um dos bebês, finge ser sua mãe e se torna noiva de Élio. Seis anos depois, Sheila retorna como a famosa perfumista Sílvia, expõe as mentiras de Catarina, se reúne com seu filho roubado e se apaixona por Élio.

title: Amores ao Cair da Tarde
description: Edna Pinto descobriu que o marido, Samuel Ricardo, a traía com a antiga paixão Kelly Lima, e que ele havia comprado um túmulo duplo para os dois. Revoltada, ela pediu divórcio. Após a separação, durante uma viagem para desopilar, conheceu por acaso o magnata Fernando Silveira, do Grupo QuroVasto, que se apaixonou por ela à primeira vista. Ele se fez passar por um candidato a encontro, cuidou dela com minúcia e a cortejou. Os dois se apaixonaram, mas enfrentaram a oposição dos filhos de ambos. Com sua força de caráter, Edna conquistou a aceitação da família de Fernando, e o carinho dele tocou o coração dos filhos dela. Superando obstáculos, eles finalmente se uniram — provando que os 50 anos também são a idade certa para buscar a felicidade.

title: Fadado ao Meu Vampiro Proibido
description: Durante toda a sua vida, Heather trabalhou como escrava para uma família de vampiros, até formar um vínculo inimaginável com Theo, um rei vampiro. Agora ela deve encontrar respostas para todos os mistérios: o que aconteceu com suas memórias perdidas de infância? Como aconteceu o vínculo? Theo é a morte dela ou o amor de sua vida?

title: Pai do Nada ao Trono
description: Song Shihuan renasce no dia em que é reconhecida como filha do príncipe herdeiro. Na vida passada, foi morta pela irmã gêmea. Desta vez, causa caos e escolhe o príncipe galante Qin como seu pai. Adaptado do romance Escolha o Pai Playboy que se Tornou Imperador de Kuaile Xingdailu.

title: Meu Corpo Pertence ao Chefão da Máfia
description: Aluna de Direito, Lily Wingrove está sem saída. A sua mãe está morrendo e as contas não param de chegar. Desesperada, ela assina um contrato com o jovem chefe da máfia, Eric Moretti, oferecendo o próprio corpo em troca de dinheiro. Eric atua rápido. O dinheiro aparece. As ameaças somem. Ele é cruel, mas irresistível, e cada vez que a salva, o poder dele puxa Lily ainda mais para perto. Um dia ele a coloca bem no centro do mundo de seu inimigo mortal, o famoso promotor Daniel Hayes. Para a cidade, Daniel é a própria justiça. Para a Lily, ele é paciente, gentil e tudo o que Eric não é. Ele a protege pela lei, não pelo medo. O amor dele parece puro, quase curador. Mas tem algo por baixo dessa perfeição que não bate certo. Ele sabe coisas demais, reage rápido demais, e o cuidado dele, às vezes, parece controle. Agora, dois homens lutam por ela de formas opostas: um pela dominação, o outro pela devoção. Com o tempo da sua mãe se esgotando, Lily precisa decidir em quem confiar antes que o poder do diabo e o segredo do anjo a destruam por completo.

title: Do Relâmpago ao Destino
description: Para tornar seu noivo bem-sucedido, ela o apoiava secretamente, mas não esperava que ele fizesse algo vergonhoso no dia do casamento! Quando foi maltratada pelo noivo canalha, um entregador que passava se levantou e disse que era seu namorado, então os dois se casaram rapidamente. Mas parece que ambos têm identidades ocultas desconhecidas pelo público...

title: Lima Barreto - Ao Terceiro Dia
description: On the last days of his life, while succumbing to alcoholism in a hospital, famed writer Lima Barreto chronicles his trajectory story as a black, poor writer living in Brazilian society between monarchy's dying days and early years of republic with its countless social problems, which formed the basis of his many novels.

title: Morrer a Rir - Roast ao Cancro
description: Tiago was diagnosed with cancer. As a cancer patient, he self-proposed his cancer to a Comedy Roast in order to raise funds to donate to IPO Lisboa.

title: Destinada ao Trono do Dragão
description: Depois de ser largada e humilhada pelo ex-namorado, a comum Lília resgata acidentalmente Alex, um pequeno príncipe dragão solitário, e é levada para o mundo de Sebastian Cross, o frio Rei dos Dragões. Enquanto velhos inimigos atacam e as intrigas políticas dos dragões se intensificam, Lília descobre que é, além da alma gêmea do Sebastião, o coração de uma família poderosa o suficiente para protegê-la, curá-la e levá-la ao trono do céu e da terra.

title: Assista ao Meu Casamento, e Chore!
description: Maria, filha mais velha do Grupo Ômega, cresceu tendo tudo roubado pela madrasta e pela meia-irmã. Por trás da frieza, esconde um coração frágil. Carlos, um segurança disfarçado, a machuca ao confundir Liliana com a garota da infância. Ao partir, ela reencontra Luís, que desperta de um coma, e recupera a felicidade. Quando a verdade vem à tona, Carlos tenta reconquistar Maria, enquanto Luís segue ao lado dela. O destino dos três se entrelaça em uma reviravolta sufocante.

title: Vendida ao Irmão, Grávida do Chefe
description: Enganada pela meia-irmã, Luísa Moreira passa uma noite sem saber com Ricardo Albuquerque. Dois meses depois, ela descobre que está grávida — pouco antes de ser vendida como noiva para o irmão de Ricardo. Quando a gravidez finalmente vem à tona, a Família Albuquerque explode em fúria — até o momento em que Ricardo dá um passo à frente e assume a criança como sua.

title: Black Clover S1-S2
description: Asta and Yuno were abandoned together at the same church and have been inseparable since. As children, they promised that they would compete against each other to see who would become the next Emperor Magus.

title: Para Ficar ao Meu Lado
description: Há dez anos, Aurora Martins esperou a noite toda na chuva por um amigo por correspondência que nunca apareceu - destruindo sua fé no amor. Agora, ela se casa repentinamente com um ex-marinheiro honrado, Diogo Gaio... apenas para descobrir que ele é o homem por quem ela esperou. O destino os reune, mas será que a confiança pode sobreviver à verdade?

title: Destinada ao Meu Cruel CEO
description: Heloísa e Asafe fugiram de um orfanato e seguiram caminhos separados, mas seus corações negam a separarar-se pela promessa de eternidade que eles fizeram um ao outro. Anos depois, o destino os reúne novamente, trazendo à tona um amor profundo, segredos sombrios e ecos de um passado que ainda os conecta.

title: Ao Redor do Brasil
description: Images of Marshall Rondon's expeditions through the Amazon: the rivers, Indians, towns such as Tabatinga, Iquitos and Rio Branco, taken by Major Luiz Thomaz Reis, considered his main cinematographer.

title: SeeIn AO
description: See In AO – There’s a story that must be told – hidden beneath the beautiful blue waves of this ocean city. Kyoya, a teacher at the Underocean school, lost his memory in an unfortunate accident that took place 3 years earlier and since then has been taken of by a beautiful young girl named Miyu. It’s natural that Miyu would become the center of all his wildest fantasies, but Yumi has a suspicious feeling that there may be more to Kyoya than he lets on.

title: Shinizokonai no ao
description: Masao, bullied by his teacher and his classmates, endures further torment until one day a paranormal girl covered in scars appears before him.

title: A Cama Ao Alcance de Todos
description: Erotic comedy in two segments. On the first, housewife finds her husband having sex with the housemaid. In order to avoid divorce, he promises to be faithful to her, but finds extremely hard to keep his word. The second is about a musician who places a strange bet: a sandwich in case he manages to conquer the heart (and have sex with) of a beautiful girl.

title: Viagem ao Sol
description: Just after the Second World War, 5,000 young children were sent from Austria to stay with host families in Portugal, where they could recover from the violence of war. They were often welcomed in by well-to-do families with domestic staff living in sunny villas, and for most of the children this was a holiday in paradise. The contrast with their living conditions at home, and the huge difference between the lives of rich and poor in Portugal in this period, made a deep impression on the young Austrians.

title: O Deus Preso ao Destino
description: Fernando, um deus de mais de dois mil anos, foi enganado pela matriarca da família Soares a assinar um contrato, obrigando-o a protegê-la três vezes. Na terceira, ele salva Rafaela de um perigo mortal e acredita ter conquistado sua liberdade. Porém, o inesperado acontece: o pingente sagrado se parte, e cada metade entra em seus corpos. A partir daí, Fernando descobre que não pode mais se afastar de Rafaela a mais de três metros.

title: Algemada ao Chefe da Máfia
description: Sophie passa uma noite com Noah, chefe da máfia, e acaba engravidando. No momento do parto, sua irmã Grace a trai, fazendo-a assumir a culpa por um acidente. Presa, Sophie tem sua identidade roubada por Grace, que toma seu lugar e, ao lado da filha Alice, procura Noah para se tornar sua amante em sua luxuosa casa..

title: Ao Haru Ride S2
description: Revolves around Futaba, a girl who was in love with a boy named Ko Tanaka in middle school. However, it did not work because he transferred but in high school, her world is turned around once again when she meets him again.

title: A Todo Vapor, Rumo ao Amor
description: Alícia, filha única de um dos dez homens mais ricos do mundo, foge de casa para escapar do controle do pai e casa-se com Reinaldo, que construiu fortuna do zero. Mas ele, enfeitiçado por Patrícia, que finge ser herdeira, pede o divórcio e a abandona. Alícia entra em um casamento de fachada com Fabiano, que também busca escapar de uma união arranjada. Unidos pelo desejo de viver sem medir tudo pelo dinheiro, acabam se encontrando um amor inesperado.

title: Olhos d'Água: Da Lanterna Mágica ao Cinematographo
description: More than 10 years of research, several trips and visits to museums, film libraries, libraries, public and private collections, and a tireless work of footage and interviews, a film that tells the pre-cinema's history in Brazil, especially in the Amazon, with the city of Belém as the protagonist of this surprising story in an unexpected scenario.

title: Ap' ta Ierosolyma me agapi
description: Martha is locked up in a psychiatric hospital by her own husband who oversees her property. But at some point, with the help of her husband's brother who studied medicine abroad, she escapes and returns home to see her daughter.

title: Hard Knock TV
description:
Launching HARD KNOCK TV in 2005, Nick Huff Barili, a veteran in the entertainment industry, recognized the need for credible in-depth coverage of Hip Hop culture and the emergence of new media. In 2006 Hard Knock TV became the FIRST Hip Hop show to create original content for Youtube. Hard Knock TV's Youtube channel has over 100 million views and 170 thousand subscribers, featuring some of the most viewed video interviews for some of today's stars such as Pharrell, Outkast, Wu-Tang, Common, Public Enemy, Kendrick Lamar, J Cole, ASAP Rocky, Logic, Jessie Reyez, Childish Gambino, Saweetie and Cordae.

In 2019 Nick launched Hard Knock TV Latino to showcase in-depth conversations (in Spanish and English) with Latino talent including J Balvin, Nicky Jam, Residente, Nicki Nicole, C Tangana, Bizarrap, Sech, Snow Tha Product, Cypress Hill, Farina and many more.

Being at the forefront of the video new media wave, Hard Knock TV has developed into a premier multi-platform video production and entertainment company, focusing on music, culture, sports and lifestyle. With thousands of hours of original programming being produced, aggregated, and distributed worldwide, Hard Knock TV has established itself as the go-to destination for original in-depth entertainment content. Delving into both the mainstream and underground world, Hard Knock TV digs beneath the surface for thought provoking content. Hard Knock's discerning and independent editorial voice, has earned a reputation in the entertainment industry as being the "Curators of Fresh".

Hard Knock TV lives up to the motto "Curators of Fresh" because of their unparalleled track record for being the first to discover emerging trends and talent on the rise to super-stardom. Nick has had the opportunity to interview and expose new artists to a large audience, often before they become household names providing audiences with their first in-depth good look at some of today's brightest talent.

title: Byw Celwydd
description: Drama portraying the conflict between fictional journalists, advisors and politicians who are all members of fictional parties in Cardiff Bay. Following elections, a coalition is in power, between three parties, The New Conservatives, Nationalists and The Democrats with the Socialists in opposition.

title: 35 Diwrnod
description: The series begins with the body of Jan Richards in her home on a well-off suburban housing estate. We're immediately thrown back 35 days, to the day Jan moves to the estate. From that day until her death, 35 days later, we'll unlock her past and find out why she was on the Crud yr Awel estate.

title: To gelio vgike ap' ton Paradeiso
description: A successful industrialist tries to persuade his daughter to marry his gangling and kind partner. A bogus affair with the seductive femme fatale, Gisela Dali, would do the trick; however, what happens if her jealous fiancé finds out?

title: Gabros ap' ti Gastouni
description: A shepherd with a heart of gold finds himself in bustling Athens to work in one of his uncle's souvlaki joints. Instead, he decides to help his love-smitten cousin and her beau. Will the groom from Gastouni find a better future in Athens?

title: The First Aggregate
description: A struggling Mongolian stuntman returns to the big city after suffering a serious head injury but soon finds himself thrust back into the fray when presented with an opportunity to become a serious actor.

title: Com chuva no verão de solares
Ap Gep Jai Wai Glai Tur
Hip Hop Treasures
description: Features LL Cool J and Ice T, rap icons and TV stars, as they hunt for hip hop's most sought-after memories.

title: Rough Cut
description: Based on Iwan 'Iwcs' Roberts' first novel, we follow the troubled story of the main character, Carbo, and accompany him on an exciting and entertaining journey as he is drawn into a world of wrongdoing, lies, secrets and heartbreak.

title: STREETBEEFS | AP vs PSYCHO LUDA
description:
Streetbeefs operates 100% legally, with every participant 18 or older stepping in by choice. Founded by Scarface, Streetbeefs was featured in The New York Times documentary “Guns to Gloves” and highlighted in ESPN The Magazine (February 2019), putting a spotlight on a different way to handle conflict.

After witnessing too many people in the area seriously hurt — or worse — over pointless disputes, a solution was created: bring it to Satan’s Backyard and put the gloves on. No guns. No knives. No jumping. Just you, your opponent, the referee, and a crowd watching it unfold.

Hundreds of disputes have been settled this way, with the goal of settling thousands more — turning chaos into controlled combat. Some fights are strictly sport, some are real beef, but every match is real and raw. Streetbeefs isn’t just fights — it’s a brotherhood, a place where aggression gets redirected, bonds are built, and problems get handled without bodies dropping or lives being ruined.

title: As Husbands Go
description: On their last night in Paris, Lucille Lingard and her traveling companion, widow Emmie Sykes, are squired around town by their new European gentleman acquaintances, Ronald Derbyshire and Hippolitus "Hippy" Lomi. The two are upset because they must leave their newly acquired Continental friends for their Dubuque, Iowa homes. On their voyage home, Lucille complains to Emmie that her good-natured, though boring, Midwestern husband is no match for the charming and sophisticated Ronald, whom she left behind. Emmie, who is older than Lucille, her daughter Peggy and Peggy's fiance, Jake Canon, all live with Lucille and her family. Emmie is distressed that she has been unable to get her daughter to approve of her new relationship with Hippy. Despite their commitments at home, both women had promised their European lovers to return to them some day, and Lucille had promised Ronald to divorce her husband. Lucille and Emmie make a pact to pursue their new goals without distraction. While crossing the Atlantic, Lucille and Emmie unexpectedly receive word that Hippy and Ronald plan to follow them to America. Meanwhile, Charles makes special preparations for his wife's return by adopting his nephew Wilbur into the Lingard family. Lucille arrives in Dubuque but shows nothing but disdain for her husbands's bland Midwestern lifestyle and longs for a return to Ronald. When Ronald and Hippy arrive, Charles senses that Ronald is interested in Emmie, not realizing he has come for Lucille. As Charles and Ronald get to know each other, however, they become fast friends and get drunk on a fishing expedition. In their drunken chatter, Ronald admits to Charles that Lucille does not look as glamorous to him in America as she did in Europe, and confesses that he is really too selfish to love a woman the same way Charles does. Meanwhile, Peggy's heart softens about her mother's love for Hippy, and she realizes Emmie is truly happy with him. The next day Lucille is told that Ronald has left, and she happily returns to her husband, finally realizing the value of their marriage and the joy her new family will bring to her.

description: Rosemary Barton, the beautiful wife of a top attorney, dies during their anniversary party at an exclusive restaurant. Later a suicide note is found along with traces of cyanide in her drink, but murder cannot be ruled out.

title: Direct au coeur
description: Kid Marc is an upcoming boxer about to become the European Lightweight Champion, only he discovers his surprising victories had been handled by his manager, César Cannebois. This time, he vows to win on his own merits, to show his girlfriend how good he really is - and chiqué is stronger, and he loses in the ring. All glamour gone, everybody abandons him, save for his loyal and loving girlfriend. Régina is going to be his queen.

title: The Ribbon Hero
description: Sapphire is the princess of a kingdom that no longer exists. Having lost everything in her homeland of Silverland to the calamity known as "Nergal," she wanders in despair until she finally arrives in Goldland.

description:
En sauvant une petite fille d'un accident de voiture, Grayson fut irrémédiablement lié au destin des jumeaux. Emma et Lucas, son frère, entreprirent aussitôt de jouer les Cupidons pour leur mère Hailey et ce sauveur providentiel.

title: Leyla Zana, le cri au-delà de la voix étouffée
description: Leyla Zana, the first woman Kurdish MP to be elected to the Turkish Parliament in 1992, was impisoned in 1994 for 15 years for speaking in Kurdish in the Parliament. Kudret Gunes' personal look at the life of Zana takes her to her birth-place, friends and exiled husband.

title: Invincible au village, faible ailleurs
description: Fabien entre dans le jeu pour sauver sa sœur, mais il se fait harceler et bloquer au village débutants par un antagoniste. Quand les démons attaquent, il active le « Système d'invincibilité du nouveau » et, niveau 1, tue un général démon et un seigneur démon à mains nues. Pour éviter que les cœurs de démon ne polluent le village, il accepte une mission d'escorte afin d'obtenir une « carte d'invincibilité ». Sans buff, il quitte le village, donne son équipement légendaire à des inconnus, et ses coéquipiers, croyant qu'il est un génie caché, éliminent tous les monstres sur son chemin jusqu'à la capitale. Là, l'antagoniste le provoque devant tous. Bloqué, Fabien est sur le point d'être touché quand le système lui accorde la « Carte d'essai de puissance divine ».

title: Catch a Fire

title: La femme au foyer qui a touché les étoiles

Après que Monica ait comploté pour monter la famille de Rita contre elle, Rita s'est lancée dans la recherche spatiale, le cœur brisé. Son départ a semé le chaos familial, révélant la tromperie de Monica. Finalement, bien que la famille repentante ait cherché à se réconcilier, Rita a privilégié sa carrière.

title: Ne vous frottez pas à une mère au cœur dur

Un combat épique s'annonce entre la mère protectrice et le puissant seigneur, mettant en jeu le destin de sa famille et de la nation.

title: Nabil Anane : Le Combattant Français Qui DÉTRUIT au ONE Championship 🔥
description:

Dans cette vidéo, découvrez comment Nabil Anane est passé de combattant prometteur à l'un des strikers les plus redoutés du circuit international. Technique parfaite, puissance explosive et mental d'acier : Nabil possède tous les ingrédients des plus grandes légendes du Muay Thai.

en passant par ses combats les plus spectaculaires et ses KO les plus impressionnants, revivez l'ascension fulgurante de celui qui pourrait devenir le nouveau Buakaw français.

title: Undress Me
description: Mikaela had a sex reassignment surgery . One night out she meets a guy who follows her home. The movie Undress me examines our perceptions of gender and how our identity can be formed by the perceptions of others.

title: Mad Maxime: Revenge
description: A virus has turned the world in an post-apocalyptic wasteland. The wanderer Maxime stumbles upon a scientific community who have created a cure. But, they are under siege by a large group of bandits.

title: AV Idol
description: Ryoko a talented, popular and vaunted adult film actress has a film shooting in Seoul, the capital of South Korea on her schedule next. She has it in her so this will be no problem. Unfortunately, she can take only so much of what comes to her in South Korea. Problems arise as soon as she takes in Incheon International Airport. She has to embrace the inexperienced crew and swallow hard when the low budget blocks her creativity and zeal. Then comes a South Korean actress who is thrust into the menage without really having the experience for it.

title: Buzz Aldrin, What Happened to You in All the Confusion?
description: A man is almost obsessed with being anonymous, and never the best in anything. Being second means being unnoticed and forgotten--but still important as a human.

title: Av hjärtans lust
description: The baron of Qvinnevad Castle has financial problems and is forced to show the estate to tourists. The baron finds out that an unknown person is trying to acquire the castle.

title: Filmen som inte blev av
description: "The Film That Didn't Get Made" - What happens to a human being when she retires and no longer has the job to lean on?

title: Hjärta av sten
description: Josefin, a young woman, becomes a witness to a homicide but doesn't dare to tell what she has seen.

title: Ägd av Danny
description: With hidden cameras, Danny Saucedo is pranking people.

title: Ballar av stål
description: Balls of steel is a Swedish television series produced by Strix Television. The program is based on the British model set Balls of Steel produced by Channel 4th.

title: Minnet av Ingmar Bergman
description: "Without Bergman, I would be someone else," Jörn Donner has said on several occasions. Now Donner has made a trip to Fårö and dug into his archives and the result has been " The Memory of Ingmar Bergman". A film in which Donner recalls his relationship with Ingmar Bergman, a relationship that began when Donner was 16 and saw the film "Prison" and ended with Bergman's death in 2007. It is also a film about loss. And a film with some completely unpublished material.

title: Repmånad eller Hur man gör pojkar av män
description: Jonsson is called back for refresher training. He meets Lövgren, Larsson and others who aren't very serious but instead, see it as an opportunity to have fun for a month away from work.

title: Glimt Av Norge Trollstigvegen
description: Short documentary series about places all over the country.

title: Olav Hardeberg - Biter av et puslespill
Malibu Spring Break
description: Two Arizona girls head out to the Malibu beaches for a springbreak of partying and fun in the sun.

title: Fångad av en röst
description: Young secretary Britt Lind often visits a record shop where you can make your own recordings. She tries in vain to get the director of Bellaccord to listen to them.

title: A Matter of Life and Death
description: With a deadly curse counting down the days, a reckless young woman forces a stone-cold heart surgeon into a wild pact to outsmart death sparking chaos, comedy, and an impossible love story against the clock.

title: Men in White
description: Four people from Singapore die on the same day and return to Earth as ghosts.

title: Samjin Company English Class
description: In the mid '90s, three female high school graduates working in an office take English classes together to earn promotions. Then, they team up to uncover corruption within their company.

title: The Defining Moment
description: Groomed for business by her grandfather since young, Lin Kexin (Fann Wong) is appointed CEO of his conglomerate straight after graduation, with vehement protests from her uncle Tang Weiye (Hou Ren Choo). But Kexin soon finds herself suffering from uncontrollable hysteria, and fears she has inherited her grandmother's mental illness. Weiye took advantage of the situation by forging a medical report to declare her insane and took reins of the business. Convinced of her own illness, the once aggressive and arrogant Kexin slips into a depression and attempted suicide. Her siblings Kexi (Andie Chen) and Keyi (Jeanette Aw), whom she was estrange from, begin to rally around her. With her family's encouragement and love, Kexin recovers and gains not just a new perspective in life. Weiye's mis-management is leading the company into trouble. Will Kexin be able to turn the tide around with the support of her family?

title: X yuansu
description: Zhiqing has a special gift - the ability to see a person for who they really are inside. Together with Jiang Wei, an eccentric private investigator, she faces a series of mysterious events involving alternate dimensions.

title: Till We Meet Again
description: Tripitaka (Elvin Ng), Monkey God (Kingone Wang), Pigsy (Ian Fang) and Sandy (Steven Chiang) met with a calamity while on their journey to the West, due to Flower Fairy Caiyue's (Julie Tan) mistake. Tripitaka, Pigsy and Sandy died as a result of that. Out of despair, Monkey God swore before dying that he will never forgive Caiyue. Unbeknownst to them, the tragedy was orchestrated by the Nine-Tail Vixen (Ann Kok). Out of desperation, Caiyue visited the Goddess of Mercy to beg for a second chance, she was granted 1,000 years to locate the reincarnated Monkey God. Caiyue finally locates him, reincarnated as Zhao Yaojin, at the end of 1,000 years. Caiyue hopes to seek forgiveness and return to the journey to the West. Unfortunately, Yaojin does not have any memory of his past life, neither was he interested in journeying to the west. Faced with the love of her life remembering nothing, how will Caiyue gain the forgiveness she yearns, and will they ever return to complete their journey to the West?

title: Emerald Hill: The Little Nyonya Story
description: When a woman learns she is the long-lost daughter of the wealthy Zhang family, her life goes from improvised to full of upper-class drama.

title: Holland V
description: The life of the Mo family, which operates a small restaurant in Holland Village in Singapour.

title: Dear, Dear Son-in-Law
description: Jiang Wencai (Hou Ren Choo) seems to have it all, a stable career and a happy family, until his eldest daughter Jiang Yijuan (Priscelia Chan) unexpectedly announces her engagement to an assistant designer, Zhang Shunfa (Pierre Png). Distrustful of Shunfa and yet unable to express his objections, Wencai offers to rent a room to him so that he can chaperone the couple as he plots to break them up. But soon, Wencai realizes that his future son-in-law is not his only problem. His eldest son Junji (Yaodong Zhang) is being led into risky investments by his capricious mother-in-law; his second daughter Yijun (Jeanette Aw) whom he was proud of returned from abroad without completing her degree; his neglected teenager son and daughter also get into trouble behind his back. In turn, it was Shunfa who helps him resolve his family problems. Unable to take the many setbacks, Wencai collapses and falls sick. He then conceives a scheme with Shunfa to teach his children a lesson.

title: The Champion
description: Brace yourself for the next hot wave in Asia with an ultra Cool cast in a splashing Hot Drama. Get ready for the perfect storm when MediaCorp Studios stirs up a potent mix of love, youth and adrenaline into the choppy waters of The Champion. Hell breaks lose when an ambitious coach (Hsing-shu Yen) takes over the training of the women swim team. He places high hopes on the most promising swimmer (Jeanette Aw) who fails to live up to his expectations because of excessive family burdens. In between clashes, they developed feelings for each other until the untimely return of his ex-wife - Swim buddies (Fiona Xie) and (Joyce Chao) compete not only in the pool but also in their quest for love. Trouble brews when both fall for the same guy (Toro) from the water polo team. Ironically, their siblings (Yuwu Qi) and (Jesseca Liu) get entangled in yet another game of unrequited underwater love when the latter decides to turn his attention to another - Things get heated up when the competition draws near - Will the trials of true friendship and the turbulence of courtship cause them to falter? Or will it fuel their drive to excel in the sport they love?

title: Economy Watch
description: The series follows TV host and self-proclaimed economist David Johnson as he explains economic topics in a humorous way.

title: The Scam Artist
description: In a near future America ruled by corporations, the Devil is in the details and nothing is what it seems. When the daughter of a wealthy CEO and her boyfriend scheme to fake her kidnapping and skip the country with a small fortune, her lover solicits the help of a seasoned freelance mercenary; but everyone has ulterior motives. As their plan spirals out of control, the three partners in crime come face-to-face with their own inner demons. Soon, two men's greed and one woman's desire lead to murder... and a horrifying personal revelation.

title: Blödaren
description: On tour through Sweden, the all-girl rock 'n' roll band "Rock Cats" suddenly find themselves trapped in no-man's land when their tour-bus breaks down. Soon they get to meet "the Bleeder", an insane beast of a man whose sole interest is to kill them all off, one by one. The hunt is on...

title: Coastguard Dutch Caribbean
description: Follow the team of Coastguards operating around Curacao, Aruba and St. Martin. They work hard daily to fight drug trafficking, prevent illegal immigration and manage numerous rescue missions, with support from the Dutch Royal Navy and US Coastguard.

title: Girls Like Us 2.0! The Hustle! The Game
description: It's a story about a woman who must figure out how to get out of an abusive relationship at the hands of a woman without losing her life!

title: Bu Kizin Öyküsü
description: The success story of nine different young women with the documentary "This Girl's Story" will be featured on BluTV as a documentary. The documentary series, which tells a different story every week, will last nine weeks in total. The documentaries have made their own story and will be confronted with the adventure of every young woman who has drawn her own path.

title: ¡Ay dios mío! ¡Eres mi papá bebé!
description: Después de que su propio prometido la deja para morir en un incendio, Aria se ve atrapada en un romance inesperado con el multimillonario Casper Bennet, cuyo hijo Leo de 6 años insiste en que ella es su madre. ¿Es posible que Casper realmente sea ese hombre de esa noche hace 7 años, y Leo es realmente su hijo?

title: Ay Lav Yu
description: Ibrahim returns to Tinne, along with his girlfriend, Jessica, but will the tiny village become their new home?

title: Sana ay ikaw na nga
description: The story revolves around two lovers whose romance is against all odds. Carlos Miguel Altamonte, a handsome, rich guy, meets the poor but charming barrio lass, Cecilia Fulgencio. It was love at first sight for both of them. There's a hitch, however, Carlos Miguel is trapped in an arranged marriage with Olga Villavicer, a woman he doesn't really love. Yet, Carlos Miguel and Cecilia's love for each other proves strong enough to motivate the former to back out to the designed commitment and pursue his newfound bliss. Carlos Miguel fought for his love for Cecilia and succeeded in wooing her to tie the knot with him. On the other hand, Olga, unable to accept defeat, sets an evil plan into action. A scheme that will entirely change Cecilia's life and worse, lose her own identity.

description: Sudetenland, May 1945. A group of retreating German soldiers capture a group of young workers, totally deployed in a chemical factory. Along with them to hide in a nearby mansion, which soon becomes a place of last fight which is in the minds and in the turbulent backdrop of war Czechoslovakia, shortly before the liberation. Psychological probe, as well as intimate drama of a small castle in the middle of the wall is a mosaic fate mapping short stories, attitudes and thoughts of individual characters on both sides of the barricades.

The idea that they might pay off their debts even drives an indebted traveller, poor watchmaker and an office servant to a murder attempt.

The young people are represented by the "jampec" Tóni Swing, a fan of Western dance music and aficionado of fashionable dances. As a counterpoint, the young, innovative workers appear, who represent a positive direction in music as well.

title: Qi zhi hu li ba tiao gou
LAGUNA peeps, swerte ba sa game arena?
description:
Kaunting stretching na lang, weekend na! Kaya huwag na init ulo, palamig ka muna. Grab your favorite summer treat. Sabayan na rin 'yan ng 'hugot' sound trip. Press play, yearning ay ibuhos habang pinakikinggan ang harana ni Erik Santos.

Pwede 'to sa mga naging bulag sa pag-ibig—mukhang aminado d'yan si Erik. Pero sabi nga sa kanta niyang "Love Will Lead You Back," maging hopeful lang dahil saan man dalhin ang puso, babalik at babalik ito sa tunay na itinadhana sa'yo.

Itinadhana nga ba sa swerte ang mga taga-San Pedro, Laguna sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena? Kinilala ng hosts si player Che, na taga-bantay ng CCTV. Si Vhong Navarro, parang may gustong makita sa CCTV camera. Kuys, ano nga ba?

Hindi naman sa pagiging bitter, pero si Jackie Gonzaga, napa-reminisce sa kape-ling niya, hanggang sa nauwi sa pagalingan ng joke ang kuwentuhan. Sino ba ang may pinakamagandang kape hugot na bebenta sa tawanan? Agaw-pansin din ang astig body art ni Jasmine, ang rocker chick ng San Pedro. Struggle is real man sa pagsagot ni Ryan Bang, 'di bale, nakaka-good vibes naman ang ‘oppa’ na medyo buhol-buhol ang dila.

Si Menard, na expert sa customer service tungkol sa internet connection, maging expert din kaya sa jackpot round ng 'Laro Laro Pick'? Malakas kaya ang signal sa tawaran? Muntik pang mauwi sa LQ ang laro, nang si Menard, suwayin ang gusto ni misis. Mas okay na nga naman kasi 'yung sigurado, kaya P35,000 ang maiuuwi niyang papremyo.

Fourth day ng ng Region 11 bakbakan sa 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan.' Feeling hinaharana sina hurado Klarisse De Guzman, Erik Santos, at Jed Madela.

Para ibida ang talento, hawak ni Alyssa ang mikropono sa 'TNT' entablado. "Die On This Hill" ang bitbit niyang piyesa. Si Francis ang ikalawang kalahok. Sa kan'yang pag-awit ng "The Greatest Love Of All," ika'y mapapa-stop, listen and look.

Sa dulo, si Francis ang itinanghal na panalo matapos makakuha ng grado na 90% laban sa 89.7% ni Alyssa.

title: Be-Lagaam
description: Ajit Pal is a wealthy U.K. based businessman of East Indian origin. He has a son, Rajeshwar, who lives with Ajit's friend in India. Rajeshwar is prone to all the bad habits possible, but manages to keep away from the clutches of the police. Then one day he sees a beautiful young woman (Madhu) jogging, and decides to have her for himself at any cost. He starts stalking her, and even plants a wireless camera in her bedroom so as to spy on her. One day while following her, he accosts and confronts her and tells her of his love for her, but she rejects him and asks him to leave her alone. He refuses to listen, and tries to force himself upon her but she is saved with the timely arrival of her Police Inspector boyfriend, Vijay. Rajeshwar is arrested and held in prison, but is soon released when a high-priced lawyer is hired by Ajit. Vijay and Madhu hope that it is the last they have seen of Rajeshwar, and return to their romance. But Rajeshwar has not forgotten Madhu, nor of his humiliation at the hands of Vijay. He manages to follow Madhu, confronts her, and has his way with her, and leaves her for dead to carry on with his irresponsible lifestyle. When Vijay finds out that his sweetheart is dead, he is beyond himself and goes on the rampage, looking for Rajeshwar. Before Vijay could even trace him, Rajeshwar finds out that his friends, who had aided him against Madhu, are dying one by one. One is hit by a truck, the other is electrocuted in his bathtub, and a third falls from a cliff. What or who is killing these men, and is Rajeshwar going to be the next victim. Watch as event unfold, pitting Rajeshwar against a force that he, nor his father, can do anything about.

title: Dare to Be
description: Dare to Be, weaves together three distinct stories, as characters grow and move through their development from High School to Collegiate and for some even into Elite Rowing. The audience will first be educated to the fundamentals of rowing, as it follows a group of high school girls who are drawn to the sport for various reasons as middle scholars. The film follows these young women from their early days in "Learn to Row," through their growth and development into intense high school rowing. Audience members experience the power of the girls, who while discovering the sport also discover themselves. The film also explores the question of when it is that an individual makes a leap to believe in oneself as someone special. Throughout the film, the meaning of success and the factors surrounding its definition will be a prevalent theme. The stories of the high school rowers will also navigate the choppy waters of college recruiting. The second story, Collegiate Rowing, will follow the tradition and ground breaking accomplishments of women's college rowing. This will be accomplished at a personal and institutional level, as we follow specific athletes on their college journey. Some of these athletes are ones we met in the High School narratives, and they serve as a connecting line of the film, tying the different sections together. The third story, Elite Rowing, will follow 2012 Olympians Sara Hendershot and Sarah Zelenka on their journey to make it back to the 2016 Olympics in Rio. It will also feature other former Olympians, such as Erin Cafaro, Taylor Ritzel, Mary Whipple and Sarah Trowbridge, as they share their own stories.

description: GHOST (Ryoo Seung-Wan) Seung-ho is a high school student who is deeply engaged in an online community and has a crush on a girl member named Sunshower, whom he has never met. One day, Sunshower makes slanderous remarks in the chatroom and suddenly leaves, upsetting other members. Then Seung-ho gets a message from Sunshower, "Help me." I SAW YOU (Han Ji-Seung) In a world where a vaccine has allowed zombies and humans to coexist, the zombies have erased their memories with amnesia-inducing drugs and live the life of slaves. In a factory where they work, a site manager, Youl, treats them with contempt, but despite being mistreated, a girl zombie named Si-wa follows him around. One day, Si-wa collapses from overwork and Youl has no choice but to apologize to her. When the two are left alone in the room, he is overcome with a strange feeling. PICNIC (KIM Tae-Yong) Soo-min lives with her mom and a six-year-old brother with autism. Even though she is a child herself, she has to take care of her brother. Her only joy in life is reading comic books but one day, her brother ruins her favorite book so she makes a big decision. She decides to go on a picnic with her brother where she leaves him in a Buddhist temple and walks away.

title: Game of Wisdom
description: Northern Machinery Corporation was going bankrupt because of maladministration. Sun Heping, an overseas sales manager in Southeast Asia, was called back in an emergency to take over the job as the director of Northern Machinery Plant. Years of work in the international market gave Sun Heping a market-oriented sense, so he led Northern Machinery Plant to join Hanzhong Group, where his old classmate Yang Liu was in charge. Sun Heping began to introduce plenty of bold and profound changes in the corporation. After years of development, Northern Machinery Plant was brought to life from the edge of bankruptcy and successfully entered the stock market in Hong Kong. For the integration of the heavy-duty vehicle industry and the bigger and stronger development of Northern Machinery Plant, Sun Heping actively sought the acquisition of Red Star Heavy-duty Vehicle Corporation, which his old classmate Liu Biding had some holdings in. But Yang Liu tried every possible way to stop him, because Yang thought they should build Hanzhong Group, instead of Northern Machinery Corporation, into a world-class enterprise in the heavy-duty vehicle industry. These three entrepreneurs full of dreams were once classmates, but later they decided to start a breathtaking game with each other for the long-term development of China's heavy-duty vehicle industry. In the end, they made their own contributions to China's dream in manufacture from different perspectives.

title: In the Afternoon Shade
description: A seemingly ordinary day in the life of Quentin, a Parisian film-lover. After going to the cinema twice, he runs into a former college friend, listens to a girls' conversation in a bar, then goes and meet his best friend, has a beer, and ends up spending the evening in the Parc Montsouris, where he meets Lise.

title: Hra o kámen
description: Do the Sudeten Germans who were tortured and killed during their expulsion at the end of the war deserve a monument or not? This Czech documentary shows that this is more than an intellectual question, but a political struggle. In response to a stone monument to the victims of the expulsion in Nový Bor, a group of local inhabitants has unleashed a hate-filled ritual dance of national fervor and moral outrage that turns out to be a sufficiently strong election issue as well.

title: O satrapis
description: A widower, who has acted like a real satrap to his two ex-wives, marries a girl who, in her own way, manages to change his behavior.

title: O Reencontro é o Acidente Mais Bonito
description: Lu Sihan é filha de uma família rica. Após seu pai ser assassinado e preso, sua família caiu em desgraça, e ela quase foi morta por um adúltero. Fugindo do perigo, Lu Sihan trabalhou enquanto rastreava o verdadeiro assassino que incriminou seu pai. Três anos depois, seu ex-namorado Jiangnan Hao reapareceu em sua vida. Lu Sihan sempre suspeitou que seu ex-namorado havia incriminado seu pai, então os dois iniciaram um padrão de amor e ódio. Lu Sihan e Jiangnan Hao, esse par de inimigos felizes, enfrentaram muitas disputas emocionais, ao mesmo tempo em que expuseram a mão negra por trás da armação contra a família Lu.

title: O petheropliktos
description: To cope with the incessant nagging of his meddling mother-in-law, a young lawyer seeks solace in poetry, only to end up in a psychiatric clinic after an unforeseen complication in court. Will she try to make amends by apologising to him?

title: O Abraço Corporativo
description: The press vulnerability is not a privilege of the present days. But what outlines this fragility gains in the high velocity information universe? What has changed in this game with Internet's consolidation? With the multiplication of the 24 hours news channels? With the acquisition of communication groups by entertainment industry enterprises?

title: O blofatzis
description: For the fun of it, a jolly bachelor poses as a missing-in-action Hellenic Air Force Flight Lieutenant. Soon, he meets an alleged daughter and a flirty secret admirer who is, too, willing to play games. Can he sustain his guilty white lie?

title: Fuga o Muerte
description: The story of surgeon Cristóbal Payano, who tried to rob a bank office in Santo Domingo in March 1993, in a 12-hour hostage situation that ended in tragedy.

title: Movement (R)evolution Africa
description: In an astonishing exposition of choreographic fomentation, nine African choreographers tell stories of an emergent art form and their diverse and deeply contemporary expressions of self. Stunning choreography and riveting critiques challenge stale stereotypes of "traditional Africa" to unveil soul-shaking responses to the beauty and tragedy of 21st century Africa.

title: S.O.S. Tidal Wave
description: In a city election, one of the candidates, Clifford Farrow, has a criminal background and is backed by crime boss Melvin Sutter. Sutter doesn't hesitate to escalate the violence in the face of any resistance.

title: s-CRY-ed [English]
description: 22 years ago, a bizarre uprising occurred in Japan's Yokohama region, destroying civilization, killing many, and causing the area to break off from Japan's mainland. This region came to be known as the "Lost Ground". Over the years, some of the citizens managed to erect a new city in a corner of the Lost Ground and surrounded it with a barrier to protect it from the impoverished inhabitants of the island's surrounding wasteland. However, another phenomenon began to show up in the Lost Ground: Alter, the ability to rearrange matter at the atomic level in certain ways. "Inners" who were born with Alter powers became known as Alter Users, and Alter Users who lived outside the city and misused their powers were branded "Natives". The police force known as HOLD was constructed to control Native Alter Users. A division of it called HOLY was later created and made up almost entirely of law-abiding Alter Users. Now, however, HOLD and HOLY's control over the Lost Ground has become increasingly oppressive to the point that it has started to enslave the wasteland's people. Enter Kazuma, a reckless and hotheaded Native who lives with a little girl named Kanami. Kazuma barely manages to survive off working on a farm and doing tasks for his friend Kimishima. Soon, however, Kazuma becomes caught in the conflict with HOLY and forms a fierce rivalry with Ryuhou, one of its highest officers. What is the true intent of HOLY and its leader, Martin Zigmar?

title: Life at 9
description:
The Life Series returns with two compelling new episodes as eight Australian children negotiate life in the rapidly changing world of late childhood, in the crucial few years before adolescence begins. Theyve been filmed since their first year of life, as part of a unique scientific and social experiment. Now nine, they are the public face of a pioneering longitudinal study of Australian children.

The study reveals sweeping changes to childhood, particularly in how children are spending their time. So in a Life Series first, we follow all our children from wakeup to bedtime to uncover what life is really like at nine.

In Life at 9, the kids respond to the world with new sophistication and complexity. But at the same time, their development is at a precipice. The latest scientific research tells us their levels of independence and creativity could set them up for success in later life. Yet evidence suggests that both are declining rapidly in the life of the modern child.

Through the prism of our Life Lab the kids undergo developmental and behavioural experiments with child psychologist, Dr Marc de Rosnay, and creativity expert, Dr David Cropley. How independently do they think? What kind of praise equips children to cope with failure? And can kids improve their creativity levels in just one day? Their parents are put under the microscope too. How much freedom are they giving their kids to make their own decisions? And are todays kids more creative than their parents?

The Life Series has exclusive access to a wealth of scientific findings from Australias unique federally-funded longitudinal study, Growing up in Australia, where 10,000 children and their families are interviewed over 15 years to unveil never before captured sociological and scientific data. Life at 9 runs in concert with this study and provides real life illustrations of the scientific findings, bringing a human face to the statistics.

As the nation watches the lives of our children unfold, we ask what it is that makes us all independent, creative and thriving human beings. This is Life at 9.

title: Lowlife Love
description: Tetsuo (Kiyohiko Shibukawa) is a lowlife. A film director with a small indie hit many years back, yet he has never gotten any further as he refuses to go against his 'artistic integrity'. He's a real loser. Despite being in his late 30s, he still lives with his mother and sister, borrowing money off them and scrounging from all he comes in contact with. This includes his best friend Mamoru (Yoshihiko Hosoda), who makes porn films with him for dodgy characters in order to make money, as well as the film actors' school they've setup to exploit their students as well as for him to sleep with wannabe actresses. He's a real jerk. Then one day two new students come to his school: Minami (Maya Okano), a naive and fresh girl from the countryside who wants to be an actress and Ken (Shugo Oshinari), a scriptwriter who has been living overseas. Tetsuo sees something in Minami and feels she has what it takes to be a real star and Ken has a brilliant script which could be the fantastic new project which would relaunch his career as a director, with Minami his muse. With the help of Kida (Denden), an unsavory film producer, they strive to turn this project into something tangible, but Minami's ability starts to turn the heads of other film directors such as Kano (Kanji Furutachi) and Shinjo (Kanji Tsuda) and soon Tetsuo's world starts to fall apart at the seams... Will Tetsuo's past exploits catch up to him or will he be able to hold it all together and start afresh?

description: The tower block area "Am Kölnberg" has a bad reputation.
