title: The Valley Monologues
description: A Father and a Son, separated by 28 years, connected by a letter, one writing it, the other reading it. A message about depression and suicide, and putting the pieces together years after tragic losses.

title: Inazuma Eleven GO VS Danball Senki W
description: LBX agents join forces with a soccer team from an alternative dimension to take down an enemy that puts both of their worlds into jeopardy.

title: Gamer Girl (Flipping the Score)
description: When it comes to video games Sparrow Finch is a savant. From her father's original Atari console to Virtual Reality headsets, Sparrow has always had a natural intuition for video games. One day while at an arcade called the Hive, a boy named Norman allows Sparrow to play the last player of his 'Myths and Mystics' video game. Within no time, Sparrow has completed the entire game. Something that should have taken months. Upon seeing what Sparrow has done, Norman rips the game controller from Sparrow's hands and takes credit for the unheard of accomplishment. Norman is bolstered by Hive's owner Mr. Lastrik and employee, Darryl, both of whom don't believe Sparrow, being a young girl, could accomplish such a feat. Sparrow's stolen accomplishment skyrockets Norman to video game fame and wins him enough prize money to build his own Virtual Reality Arcade, The Commune, while Sparrow is left deeply scarred, in silent unanimity. This year at Denver Comic Convention, Sparrow can finally redeem herself playing in a Myths and Mystics Virtual Reality Video Game Tournament against Norman. Sponsored by the Hive, Sparrow and her team have the opportunity to advance to Nationals in Las Vegas, where Sparrow can reveal her talent on a National stage. But a tear in the universe caused by the 'Virtual Reality Experience' transforms her into her character in the game, a powder blue super soldier and drops her in a world uncannily close to the Myths and Mystics video game. Here, Norman controls a 12 foot tyrant named Conscription who uses a spell called 'Will of Man' to control the viral males of this Universe. Potite Monarch, Sparrow's best friend and love interest is from this Alternate Universe and visits our world by way of her own Virtual Reality video game. Potite is hoping Sparrow's amazing video game skills will translate to superhuman abilities so to defend her planet Verdurous, from Norman and the evil Conscription. Potite employs her brother Maurice to guide Sparrow on her heroine's journey to defeat Conscription, get back to the Tournament and victoriously claim her Grand Champion Status and victory over her detractors.

title: Lady Newton y la Felicidad
description: Documentary about the life of a very important woman in History who we know very little about, Émilie Du Châtelet.

title: El Barbero y el Mendigo
description: A barber set in his ways gets his consciousness challenged by a homeless man who lacks the money to pay for a haircut but instead is willing to give that which keeps him warm.

title: Sex, Love and Other Perversions
description: Eight shorts, each of them dealing with the themes of sex, love and perversions.

title: Los libros y la noche
description: Documentary whose theme is aspects of the life of Jorge Luis Borges.

title: Cofralandes, segunda parte: Rostros y rincones
Hija de Fuego y Destino
description: Zhao Cuiping se lastima mientras trabaja para pagar la educación de su hija, Jin Feng. Cuando Jin Zhigang busca fondos para el tratamiento, Jin Feng recibe su aceptación universitaria. Jin Yan ayuda, y al partir, las mujeres del pueblo depositan sus esperanzas en Jin Feng. Ocho años después, Jin Feng regresa durante el funeral de su abuelo, donde las mujeres son excluidas del templo ancestral. Jin Feng retribuye al pueblo con dinero, decidida a luchar contra la opresión masculina. En el templo, descubre que Jin Yan podría ser su madre biológica, pero esta elige a su hermano, decepcionando a Jin Feng. Un asesino ataca, los aldeanos protegen a Jin Feng, quien salva al personal del laboratorio, solo para descubrir que el profesor es su padre biológico. ¿Qué destino le espera a Jin Feng?

title: Mi amante mafioso y protector
description: Serena Hale era una esposa devota. Pero su esposo no la había tocado en meses. Así que cuando un extraño la sacó de un bar una noche, ella se entregó a él, porque bajo los efectos de las drogas, pensó que era su esposo. Un error. Ese extraño es Evan Knight, el rey multimillonario del bajo mundo que ahora financia la empresa de su esposo. Él sabe que está casada. No le importa. La ha estado esperando durante dieciséis años, desde la noche lluviosa en que salvó a un niño golpeado en un callejón y ni siquiera recordaba su rostro. Pero él lo recordaba todo. Su piano. Su voz. La forma en que la lluvia se aferraba a su vestido blanco. Ahora él se sienta frente a ella en cada cena, observa a su esposo fingir devoción y susurra: 'Tú no le perteneces'. ¿Y la peor parte? Ella empieza a darle la razón. Incluso cuando descubre que su esposo asesinó a sus padres. Incluso mientras planea su venganza. Solo hay un hombre a quien le confía el arma. Pero confiar en él significa traicionarse a sí misma. Y ya se enamoró de él.

title: Llamas de amor y deseo
description: Tras una noche, Eric Chacón no puede dejar de pensar en Nadia Silva. Al enterarse de que ella está decidida a complacer a su esposo, le ofrece ayuda—pero no de la manera que ella espera. Nadia cree que Eric le enseñará el arte de la seducción, pero en su lugar, él la introduce al mundo de los idiomas extranjeros y la política, animándola a expandir su mente y a descubrir su verdadero potencial. A medida que Nadia empieza a transformarse, florece de formas que nunca imaginó.

title: El Despertar y la Venganza
description: Un par de hermanos huérfanos fueron separados en la infancia. Años después, la hermana se hizo multimillonaria y buscó incansablemente el paradero de su hermano. Mientras tanto, el hermano despertaba de un estado comatoso, y él y su esposa soportaban los incesantes abusos de los villanos. Una vez que la hermana encontró a su hermano, castigó a los que le habían agraviado, sólo para ser contraatacada por los villanos. Enfrentado a la opresión tanto de su hermana como de su esposa, el hermano finalmente reveló su verdadera identidad...

title: [Doblado]Dulces mentiras y amor
description: La vida de Lydia siempre fue amarga y llena de sufrimiento, aunque su sueño era ser pastelera y endulzar vidas con sus postres. Todo cambió cuando apareció el multimillonario Scott y, con una pequeña mentira piadosa, transformó el destino de Lydia. Lo que ella nunca supo fue que todo comenzó por un acto de bondad que tuvo... cinco años atrás.

title: Satán y su pequeña creyente
description: Poppy, de seis años, es una huérfana a la que todos acosan. Tras la muerte de sus padres, quienes murieron salvando a otros, vive sola en una choza en ruinas. En Nochebuena, accidentalmente envía su carta de deseos a Satán, porque “Santa” y “Satán” se parecen demasiado. Satán envía a su sabueso infernal de tres cabezas, Cerbero, para protegerla; disfrazado de cachorro, con dos cabezas removidas, un moño rojo atado al cuello y una amenaza resonando en sus oídos: cuida de mi pequeña creyente. Cerbero se convierte en “Pippy” para Poppy. Él ahuyenta a un vagabundo que irrumpe en su casa. Poppy descubre que puede oírlo hablar y se llena de alegría al saber que por fin tiene familia. Pero el acoso escolar no se detiene. Tyler le roba su abrigo nuevo y pisotea la manzana que ella guardó para Pippy. Satán viene a curarle las raspaduras, con el corazón doliéndole por la pequeña sin darse cuenta. Cuando la ve siendo acosada de nuevo, no lo soporta. Desciende en persona como una sombra negra gigante y hace volar a los niños crueles, y al hacerlo, rompe la ley del Infierno. Un rayo negro lo alcanza, dejándolo gravemente herido. Poppy parece sentir que alguien la salvó. Ella pala la nieve, recoge manzanas, arrastra a casa un pequeño y torcido árbol de Navidad, y graba un mensaje susurrado para el adulto que la protegió, enviándolo de vuelta con Cerbero. Solo en su gran salón, Satán presiona la muñeca grabadora una y otra vez, escuchando la voz de la niña, y siente que su corazón se ablanda. Entonces, la madre de Tyler denuncia a Poppy como huérfana, y el orfanato viene a llevársela. Ignorando sus heridas sin curar, Satán aparece como “Lucifer Morningstar” y adopta a Poppy como su hija. Dos corazones se acercan, cada uno salvando al otro. El día de Navidad, Poppy desea ver a sus padres una última vez. Lucifer asalta el Cielo, luchando contra los ángeles para traer sus almas de vuelta a ella.

title: El juramento y el huérfano
description: En tiempos de caos, un error unió a dos hombres en el odio. Víctor, un asesino despiadado, robó a la hija de su enemigo y la crio como "Orphan". Douglas, un inspector honorable, tomó al hijo de Víctor y lo llamó "Drifter". Criados en bandos opuestos de una amarga disputa, el destino los reúne de adultos, y Drifter se enamora perdidamente de Orphan, la mujer a la que nació para cazar. Al revelarse la verdad, deberán elegir: ¿destruirán los pecados de sus padres su futuro o podrá su amor reescribir un legado de venganza?

title: Revelar, alzar y reinar (Doblado)
description: ¡La primera cosa que hizo Cecilia Jiménez al terminar sus estudios fue romper con su novio Andrés Platero! Ella tenía mucho éxito en sus estudios con la ayuda de su novio y obtenía un sueldo de millones de dólares al año, pero rompió despiadadamente con él con el pretexto de que ya no estaban en el mismo nivel y que Andrés ya no era lo suficientemente bueno para ella.

title: El matrimonio ardiente y amargo
description: Mariana Jiménez, hija del hombre más rico, fue rescatada hace tres años por Gabriel Vega. Para agradecerle, lo ayudó en secreto ocultando su identidad. Sin embargo, recibió la ingratitud de él y su familia. Tres años después, despierta y regresa para reclamar su verdadero lugar como la heredera millonaria.

title: Pozegnanie z diablem

title: Exit 5
description: Recently divorced Sara decides to pursue her education abroad. Living in a conservative society, her parents refuse for her to do so until she is married once again. So she decides to search for a husband in order to travel.

title: Gate #5
description: They were young, loved adventures and had choices. In the 1960s and 70s thousands of young Lebanese left their villages and searched for a new life in the city - as countless like-minded people around the globe. The port of Beirut, the city's economic lung and central urban district, provided work for truck drivers - a job that stressed masculinity and became a lifestyle. The income allowed the young men to participate in the vibrant urban life, to enjoy their time at the always busy Burj Square with its many cinemas and restaurants as well as to start families. During the years of the civil war (1975-90) the drivers were needed to maintain the supply of food, goods, and sometime weapons between the divided sectors of country. Some were humble, others were heroic, yet all were adventurous and felt free. After the war ended the once popular Burj Square, the city's centre, was demolished, privatized and rebuild for the affluent. Lebanese economy was reorganized, thus globalized. Today fancy restaurants in the new downtown charge in Dollar and sometimes in Euro. The truck drivers' universe shrunk to the port where they offer their skills as day laborers now. Yet mostly they kill time and take long journeys in memory. One of them, Najm El Habre, is too sick to join his friends. He found a different way to carry on.

title: Police 24/7 S1-S2
description: A raw, unfiltered look into the world of sheriff and police departments across the United States.

title: Sk8 Dawg
description: Fourteen year old Tommy Schooner comes from a family whose lives revolve around skateboarding. His mom and dad own a rapidly growing skateboard company called Modern Skate that is preparing for a meeting with a large investment firm, headed by Mr. Hoffman. Also Tommy's sister is a professional skater and the public face of the company. Even his dog Buddy can shred with the best of them. While practicing skating with Buddy, Tommy accidentally runs into Frankie, a 17 year old local skater and town bully. After an argument, Tommy challenges Frankie to a skate competition. Unfortunately, Tommy didn't inherit his father's passion nor his sister's abilities, and the skate competition is in 5 days. title: Al-Nehaya
description: In 2120 Jerusalem, an engineer tries to find a solution to the energy problem in light of the restrictions that the regime imposes on the population. However, everything changes when he comes across his robotic doppelganger.

title: I Am Kevin
description: A young boy creates a make believe world to escape his truth, a world where, at the water's edge, beneath the shade of an ancient tree, a mother forms a perimeter to protect herself and her child from an unspeakable darkness.

title: Mädchen am Sonntag
description: The aura of girls doesn't need the sun to glow. That is the essence of RP Kahl's documentary "Sunday Girls", which follows four young actresses - Laura Tonke, Nicolette Krebitz, Katharina Schuettler and Inga Birkenfeld - through different seasons and landscapes. Between naiveté and experience, wishes and wants the four women tell about their jobs with great honesty. They talk about theatre, about the myths of cinema and the magic of making the first film. They show how one needs to become stubborn and uncompromising to avoid getting lost in the demands of contemporary media. These four portraits never get too close and leave the women enough freedom to experiment in front of the camera. The struggle between acting and authenticity is always visible and makes this documentary so utterly fascinating to watch.

title: I Am CCA
description: Chris Martin has been a detention officer in San Diego since 2008. The flexibility and the support system CCA provides affords him the opportunity to pursue his dream to compete as a professional boxer. "I'm very grateful for the type of job I have and the time they allow me and just the support that I get from work," Martin says. Well-liked at his San Diego facility, Martin's so unassuming, one might find it hard to believe he's a revered boxer on a national level. Boxers must adhere to a strict diet and a vigorous work-out routine the week before a fight, and Martin's warden works with him to ensure he can take vacation time off to prepare for his fights. "He's always very supportive," Martin notes. "In my second to last fight, my warden actually went to one of my fights, so I thought that was nice of him to take the time and go out and watch the fight." Martin's co-workers are his biggest cheerleaders. They often attend his fights and loyally follow his career. The immense support his work family supplies gives him confidence to continue chasing his dream, all the while providing for his family.

title: Jackie I Am 21

title: An Unappeasable Man

title: An Outpost of Progress

As time goes by, they become increasingly demoralized by their inability to profit from the ivory trade. A mutual feeling of distrust and misunderstadings with the locals isolate them at the heart of the tropical jungle. Faced with each other, they begin a journey towards the abyss.

title: Be My Valentine
description: This is a story about family, about love. It takes place in Singapore, but the modern-day friendships and conflicts reflected in it are universal. Fan Lun-tai was born in the wee hours of February 14th, given a name that just happens to sound like "valentine". The young Valentine and his little brother Leonardo are exact opposites, he, talkative and assertive, and Leonardo, reticent and shy. Yet Valentine is also very sensitive, longing for a love as strong as that between his mother and father. He has a crush on one of his classmates, the pigeon-toed and fiercely independent Bo Hsueh -but the tender- hearted little girl is moved by the attentiveness of her swimming teacher, a college student named Hsiao-hu. It is the day of Valentine's elementary school graduation, and Mrs. Fan is rushing to attend the ceremony with Leonardo, when she is fatally hit by a delivery truck from their own printing factory. From that day on, Valentine sinks into a self-punishing guilt over his mother's death, and Leonardo vents his anger at the world by hanging out with hooligans. Their father ultimately proves unable to bear the loss and drowns himself in the ocean, and the young brothers are left in the custody of an aunt. The story picks up again ten years later, when the now reclusive Valentine, troublemaker Leonardo, naive Bo Hsueh, and cocky Hsiao-hu cross paths once more.

title: A Pedra
description: Roberto Borges is a professor of the master's degree in Ethnic-Racial Relations at Cefet-RJ - a course he helped create. Professor Heloise da Costa is carrying out, in a municipal school in Vila Cruzeiro, a slum in Complexo da Penha (RJ), a project that works on the construction of the identity of black children. At 42, Adelson Martins tries to finish high school and run his own business, a locksmith, with the help of his wife. title: Apotheosis
description: Zen Luo, who is now a menial slave, used to be a young master of a big family, owing to the decline of his family, his sister is imprisoned by a strong force, he has no choice but to be at others' service. However, Every cloud has a silver lining, The ancient book left by his father actually conceals the magical spell, which can change a human into an instrument. What's the mysterious power behind all these? This is contest with fate.

title: Rebirth
description: During the Battle at the Frozen Lake, both Zhuge Yue and Chu Qiao fell into the icy waters. Chu Qiao was rescued by Yan Xun, only to learn that Zhuge Yue had perished; she subsequently sought an opportunity to assassinate Yan Xun to avenge Zhuge Yue. While in Bian Tang, Chu Qiao received repeated assistance from a mysterious man, someone who felt strangely familiar, leading her to suspect that Zhuge Yue might still be alive. Meanwhile, Yan Xun's actions grew increasingly extreme, plunging the four kingdoms into chaos. Ultimately, will Chu Qiao be able to restore peace to the realm, guide Yan Xun back from his misguided path, and reuniting with Zhuge Yue, help secure a better homeland for the people?

title: Ça, c'est Paris!
description: François, owner of Tout-Paris cabaret, struggles to decide between selling his historic venue or keeping the legacy. Amid personal stories of dancers Justine, Teresa, and Coralie, the cabaret troupe rallies to recapture its former glory.

title: Temps Perdu, Regrets Laissés ( Doublé )
description: Léa Durand est en couple avec Gaston Martin, issu d'une famille riche. Lorsque Gaston a une maladie incurable, Léa est enceinte, et apprend la véritable identité de Gaston. Pour le sauver, elle le quitte délibérément. Elle donne naissance à leur fils Arthur. Cinq ans plus tard, Arthur a un accident de voiture. Léa fait appel à Gaston. La fiancée de Gaston complote pour faire mourir l'enfant, et rejette la faute sur Gaston. Le malentendu entre Gaston et Léa s'aggrave.

title: From His Surrogate to the Royal Princess
description: Adopted by the Leora family, Omega Eve is betrayed by her sister and her mate. To them, she's nothing more than a surrogate. Then she breaks the mate bond, exposes their scheme, and turns out to be the long-lost princess of the Northern Wolf Pack. When her ex comes crawling back, she shuts him down and chooses the ever-loyal Leonard.

title: The Billionaire CEO and the Sextuplets
description: Five years ago, after one night, she got pregnant with sextuplets, and five years later, a cute kid saved the CEO's leg at a party and called him Daddy？！

title: Reborn: My SSS Snow Leopard Bride

title: Wasted Devotion, Rightful Love（DUBBED）
description: For ten years, Elena Hart loved Ethan Reed — until she catches him crossing lines with her comatose sister, Vivian Hart. Elena chooses to marry childhood protector Adrian Hale instead, but Ethan and Vivian retaliate, sabotaging her career. Fiercely protected by Adrian, Elena rises from ruin. When Vivian's true face is exposed, Ethan's regret comes far too late.

title: (Doublage) CHASSÉ, JE DEVIENS MARCHAND DES DEUX MONDES
description: (Doublage) CHASSÉ, JE DEVIENS MARCHAND DES DEUX MONDES

title: My Unicorn Girl
description: When she was eighteen, Sang Tian makes a wish to enter her mother's school to become part of the Chinese figure skating team. However, she did not pass the ranking test but somehow disguises as a guy and was accepted into the Ice Hockey team. Having no choice, she adopted a new identity. However, her plan was foiled by the sudden appearance of Wen Bing. Wen Bing and Sang Tian become room-mates. After one encounter, the two former "arch enemies" suddenly become good friends. The two of them decide to work together with their team mates and do their best in the championships. However, Sang Tian's secret was eventually exposed. Despite this, she still gets the chance to become a member of the first all-female Ice Hockey team. Sang Tian is finally able to become a real girl and continue chasing her dream.

title: Time Traveler: Saving My Family
description: Qiao Jiaojiao was reborn with merits, but accidentally traveled into a novel she had read. When she reacted, she found that she had traveled into the novel and became a cannon fodder in the novel, and she died at the age of three. Qiao Jiaojiao was speechless. Fortunately, when she was cursing the King of Hell, she accidentally found that she had a merit mall, where she could use merit points to exchange for magical pills. So Qiao Jiaojiao counterattacked and returned, trying to save this family of loyal and patriotic cannon fodder with her own golden finger, and finally changed her tragic ending...

title: D-Day: Normandy 1944
description: Allied forces invade Normandy on June 6, 1944.

title: Crise d'ado
description: Four rebellious teens risk everything searching for a lost cat. Their leader confronts a reckless cop and fallen guardian while breaking rules to succeed, his quest reopening wounds about his missing father.

title: A Poética de António Victorino D' Almeida
description: This documentary follows the interpretations solo and orchestra, of the music of the classical composer, Antonio Victorino D'Almeida, interspersed with short interviews of himself and artists like Artur Pizarro, Ingeborg Baldaszti, Maria de Medeiros, Erika Pluhar and Carlos do Carmo , among others. This is not a biographical work but a poetic journey through the composer.

title: Qaid-e-Tanhai
description: Qaid-e-Tanhai

title: Sangue e Bytes
description: Após perder contato com seus pais biológicos, Alex Webb é acolhido por Tom Finch. Ao descobrir que Neil Webb e May Green são seus verdadeiros pais, Alex retorna à família Webb. Determinado a retribuir por sua vida, ele se dedica a ser pioneiro na tecnologia revolucionária 6G. Mas dentro das paredes da família, a traição cresce. Levi Webb, o filho adotivo, secretamente sabota Alex, manchando sua reputação e roubando seu trabalho de vida. Devastado, Alex se recusa a perdoar, independentemente dos pedidos de redenção.

title: Kot-e charmi
description: Issa Farahmand is an inspector of the welfare organization who, while investigating the financial violations of one of the centers, found out about a gang of economic corruption and drug transit by mistreated girls.

title: Gonah-e man
description: A chance encounter between a thief and a troubled young woman blossoms into an unlikely friendship. As the relationship grows, the two find comfort in one another even though they were perfect strangers. However, an unexpected connection may put the new found friendship on edge.

title: Dora e ngrohtë
description: Besim does not find warmth from his stepfather Ahmet. He abandoned school and makes serious mistakes associating with bad people. But it is precisely the warm hand of classmates, his teacher and the whole of society that brings Besim back to life.

title: Doshman-e zan
description: Khosrow is a wealthy man who is still not married because ha hates women. But when his friend brings a saleswoman Soheila for playing a fake role he falls in love this time.

title: Mard-e Koochak
description: Mamal, an 11 year old boy tries to help his family ta make a living.

title: Diyar e Yaar
description: Diyar-e-Yaar is a journey of resilience, heartbreak, and the choices that define us-some for good, and some for ruin.

title: Safar-e pormajara
description: Mohsen Taban After marrying with Ahi, they travel. On the road, police inspect cars to catch thieves who have stolen a factory's cash register. In the meantime, they engage in interesting and unexpected adventures.

title: Arous-e atash
description: Ahlam who is studying medicine in the college is in love with Dr. Parviz and wants to marry him. But according to her tribe's laws and traditions she must marry her cousin Farhan. She decides to face her family and find a solution.

title: Project G-7
description: Mark and Wright are the leaders of a smuggling squad.

title: Gundam Reconguista in G [English]
description: The Universal Century has passed. Humanity's prosperity has ushered in a new era of global peace known as the Regild Century. Bellri Zenam, a pilot training with the Capital Guard, is chosen by the G-Self, a highly maneuverable Mobile Suit of unknown origin, operable only by a select few. These select few embark on a journey that will change the course of the Regild Century forever.

title: K Beauty Salon
description: Last April, BTS, the Korean boy band, was chosen by the Times magazine as one of the world's 100 most influential people in 2019. The Korean wave, now a worldwide phenomenon, also includes K-beauty, the Korean way of beauty, fashion and style increasingly influencing the global trend. 'Beauty' Is beyond just looking good, it's more about being self-confident and loved. 'Beauty' is one of the common interests of people around the world. TBC's K-beauty salon is a 'global beauty' program that shares and empathizes 'K-beauty' with the global citizens. More specifically, it offered top-notch beauty service to the Vietnamese local residents of Danang for 3 days, by opening a special salon with Korean beauty artists and celebrities. We present an unforgettable memory to the local customers by interacting with them, under the slogan of 'beauty'

description: Twenty short films profiling people who were affected by the March 11, 2004 bombings on four commuter trains in Madrid, Spain.

title: O Areal
description: The Guajará community was formed more than 200 years ago by descendants of slaves who found their freedom there. Ever since then, the inhabitants of this place in the Brazilian Amazonia have been relatively isolated from all urban contact and its progress, maintaining a way of life linked to their ancestors and fed with a series of myths about spirits and incarnations of evil. There is a sandpit near the community, a place where spirits talk and coexist with the inhabitants of Guajará since its origin. Yet, the construction of a bridge which shall join the community with the city will compromise the sandpit and will also bring a change in the vision they have of their own existence and of their own nature.

title: O magoufis

title: Jugoslavija u ratu 1941-1945.
description: Yugoslavia at War, 1941-1945 is a 26-episode documentary series first broadcast in the early 1990s. The series includes participants and eyewitnesses from the war, as well as notable Yugoslav, British, German, Russian, and Italian historians, publicists, and journalists. It attempts to offer multiple viewpoints for significant events of that time period.

title: The Last Lions
description: Fifty years ago there were close to half-a-million lions in Africa. Today there are around 20,000. To make matters worse, lions, unlike elephants, which are far more numerous, have virtually no protection under government mandate or through international accords. This is the jumping-off point for a disturbing, well-researched and beautifully made cri de coeur from husband and wife team Dereck and Beverly Joubert, award-winning filmmakers from Botswana who have been Explorers-in-Residence at National Geographic for more than four years. Pointing to poaching as a primary threat while noting the lion's pride of place on the list for eco-tourists-an industry that brings in 200 billion dollars per year worldwide-the Jouberts build a solid case for both the moral duty we have to protect lions (as well as other threatened "big cats," tigers among them) and the economic sense such protection would make. And when one takes into account the fact that big cats are at the very top of the food chain-and that their elimination would wreak havoc on all species below them, causing a complete ecosystem collapse-the need takes on a supreme urgency.

title: Mariana y Scarlett
description: Amor, desamor, envidia y traición son los ingredientes de la nueva novela Mariana y Scarlett, la historia de dos hermanas que, sin saberlo, se enamoran del mismo hombre. Mariana y Scarlett son dos mujeres de clase media, bonitas, luchadoras y con un gran anhelo de superación. Pero ahí terminan los parecidos. Mientras Mariana es seria, dulce, serena y quiere hacer todo por el camino correcto; Scarlett es divertida, pícara, agresiva y quiere hacer todo por el camino rápido. El deseo de la primera es montar su propio taller de confecciones y hacer sus propios diseños, el de la segunda es ser una modelo internacionalmente reconocida. En su camino hacia el cumplimiento de su sueño ambas se cruzarán con Roberto White, un millonario dueño de una textilera, cuyo matrimonio está roto y que, mientras consigue el divorcio, saldrá con las dos hermanas pero con identidades diferentes. Con Scarlett será Roberto, millonario y empresario, mientras que con Mariana será Boby, empleado en una agencia de seguridad. Cuando Roberto se da cuenta de que se ha enamorado de Mariana, romperá con Scarlett, pero la dicha no lo durará mucho, ya que Mariana no tardará en descubrir el engaño, lo que le llevará a romper con él para siempre. Scarlett por su parte descubre que Roberto la abandonó por Mariana, lo que hace que su relación de hermanas se afecte de manera irreversible. Scarlett y Mariana se convierten entonces en rivales por la lucha del amor de un hombre, Roberto.

title: Palos y risas

title: Barridos y regados
description: Two men bring a message to a manager in an office with two beautiful secretaries. The manager thinks they are the specialists he is waiting for. title: Montoyas y Tarantos
description: History about hate and passion between two gypsy families.

title: Pablo y Carolina
description: Torn between three lovers and bored by her typewriting classes, Carolina (Dillian) writes a passionate love letter to fictional Pablo Garza from Monterrey. The letter is sent by mistake and received by real Pablo Garza's girlfriend. Pablo himself (Infante) flies to Mexico City looking for an explanation. Carolina is rehearsing a musical show for her school dressed as a man. When Pablo meets her, she pretends to be her brother Anibal, a shy and feminine sailor. Pablo likes Anibal and invites "him" to a cabaret. After that, Carolina falls inlove with Pablo but resists to unveil her real self. Meanwhile, Pablo feels himself confused, because young "Anibal" is cute as an angel and has "those blue eyes..."

title: Estudiantes y modistillas
description: Soledad and Lola work as seamstresses in a typical Madrid neighborhood. When Julio, a law student from a wealthy family, leaves Soledad pregnant and abandons her, she asks for help to the Paloma Virgin. Julio becomes a barrister, and has to defend an abandoned woman. Realizing his own faults, he will now get back to Soledad. Shot in Madrid on location in the Retiro park, Puerta del Sol, Paloma Church and other spots of zarzuelistic fame.

title: Mi marido y sus complejos
description: A married man can't stand his mother-in-law and lives every day waiting for the night. That's when he gets the chance to let his hair down, go to a night club and escape from the monotony of his family life.

title: Entre celos y desamor
description: Laura Rivas amó durante años a Pablo Gómez, sin saber que su afecto no era más que una estrategia para acercarla a Sergio Lima, heredero de la Mansión del Duque, y así sabotear el compromiso con Eva Santos. Al descubrir que solo fue un instrumento para provocar los celos de Eva, Laura, herida, llevó su engaño con Sergio hasta el matrimonio, mientras Pablo quedaba consumido por el arrepentimiento.

title: El amor y la ciudad

Esta es la historia de Juana, Sebastián y Elisa. Estos tres personajes habitan el mismo edificio en una imaginaria Buenos Aires. La ciudad esta vacía, diferente. Todo sucede en pocas cuadras a la redonda.

Juana es una joven artista plástica desocupada, algo desquiciada y con graves problemas económicos. Desesperada y como ultimo recurso, pide ayuda a sus padres, que viven fuera del país, pero su madre se la niega. Entonces intenta conseguir empleo en el Bar de Pedro, un bar próximo a su casa. Tampoco tiene suerte. Le queda seguir retratando a sus vecinos a los que espía y dibuja a su manera.

Elisa, tiene bien pasados los cuarenta y cinco, es una mujer un tanto frustrada no sólo en lo profesional sino también en lo afectivo. Ha sido mantenida gran parte de su vida por su padre, Carlos Miguel un reconocido escritor que vive en Paris desde hace cuarenta años. Hace cinco que Elisa no ve a su padre y es en el Bar de Pedro donde Elisa se entera por medio de los noticiosos que Carlos Miguel a sido galardonado con el premio Nobel de literatura a los 80 años. Nadie sabe en la ciudad que Carlos Miguel es su padre y Elisa no lo dirá ahora tampoco.

Sebastián tiene unos treinta y pico y un futuro incierto. Se las rebusca de hurtar y vender los libros antiguos y particulares de su único familiar, el tío Augusto, un anciano excéntrico y solitario. Sebastián convive con Elisa desde hace tiempo, se aman, están bien juntos. Elisa y Sebastián son dos seres solitarios que se tienen el uno al otro. Pero Sebastián sospecha que hay otro hombre en la vida de Elisa, alguien que vive en Paris, y eso lo tiene alterado. Elisa recibe una llamada inesperada de su padre, que le pide fervientemente que lo vaya a ver ya que acaba de ser abandonado y su casa desvalijada por su más reciente pareja Natalie. Elisa parte, sin aviso alguno hacia Paris.

Al mismo tiempo en Buenos Aires Juana sufre un desmayo en la calle y es auxiliada por Sebastián que la lleva al hospital. Al arribar a Paris Elisa y Carlos Miguel recapitulan momentos vividos, hacen un recuento sobre quienes son y lo poco que se han dejado conocer el uno al otro. A Carlos Miguel no le queda mucho tiempo de vida, el sufre de un problema de coagulación que lo desmejora día a día. Para su alivio esta allí su única hija, Elisa, quien aprende a cuidarlo. title: El CEO y la campesina
description:
Avery Rogers está pasando por muy mal momento: perdió a su padre, su novio la engañó con su hermana y un CEO despiadado puso su granja en la mira, pero esta aguerrida vaquerita de pueblo se lanza a un enfrentamiento donde vuelan las chispas contra Tyler Sinclair, el heredero corporativo enviado para tomar sus tierras. 
El deseo y la lealtad colisionan cuando en una parrillada de pueblo (el intento de Tyler de salvar a Avery y el legado de su padre) los enemigos se convierten en algo extremadamente cercano a amantes y sus mundos se ponen patas arriba.
Al principio, Avery utiliza a Tyler para vengarse de su exnovio, pero no sabes cuales son las verdaderas intenciones de Tyler. ¿Podrá Tyler cumplir su trabajo o será su amor más fuerte que su deber?

title: Sex, Shame and Tears 2
description: Twenty years have passed since those two apartments in the heart of Mexico City were the battlefield of a war of the sexes between Ana, Carlos, Andrea, Miguel, Tomás and María. All that is left of those apartments are memories and the image of Tomás' dead body at the bottom of the elevator shaft. Their lives have changed, their families have grown and new and unexpected characters have come to unsettle their daily lives and trigger a chain of events that will make them realize that modesty has been replaced by public disclosure; sex is only an app away; but love...love is still something elusive that everyone in today's banal and chaotic world is seeking.

title: A Mãe Traída é a Herdeira Divina
description: Lena é a herdeira do poder divino de Atena. Uma figura materna acolhedora e movida pela compaixão, mas que, por trás da doçura, esconde uma presença firme e imponente. Ela foi a Suprema Estrategista da lendária Ordem de Aegis, mas abandonou o poder após um incêndio devastador, há vinte e cinco anos. Naquele dia, ela arriscou a vida para salvar sete crianças e as criou como seus próprios filhos. Por décadas, Lena manteve sua identidade em segredo. Mas, no dia do seu aniversário de cinquenta anos, os sete filhos pelos quais ela sacrificou tudo são manipulados por suas famílias biológicas e se voltam contra ela, acusando-a de sequestro. Traída e de coração partido, Lena desperta o poder que estava adormecido havia tanto tempo. Não mais disposta a sofrer em silêncio, ela quer retomar o poder, revelar a verdade e lembrar ao mundo e a seus filhos por que um dia foi temida como a líder destinada a comandar.

title: Flash Marriage: My Billionaire Husband
description: Under the arrangement of her elders, she registered a marriage with a mysterious man. However, right after the wedding, he disappeared. A year later, her newly appointed, handsome, and wealthy boss always gives her a sense of familiarity.At the same time, her mysterious husband, who had been missing for a year, starts contacting her, asking for a divorce. Due to various unexpected circumstances, they couldn't manage to get divorced. As her aversion towards her mysterious husband deepened, she gradually began to feel a different kind of affection towards her boss in their interactions. And so does he.Just as they went through great effort to finally succeed in their divorce, they discovered that the person waiting for them in front of City Hall was none other than the one they couldn't help but fall in love with... He turned out to be her enigmatic husband of one year!

title: O Último Verão
description: To celebrate the end of another college year, three friends decide to have an adventurous night of summer. But things don't go according to plan.

title: Insect O Cide
description: Insect O Cide is the new feature by Georgina Willis. Something big is changing in the world of the Small. Insects are disappearing. "If all insects disappeared all life on earth would perish." Insectocide is a big film about small things.

title: Rondon, o Desbravador
description: Life and the highlights of General Rondon, a great historic leader digging into western lands and helping to integrate it to the rest of the country.

title: O megalos paramythas
description: An unemployed background actor gets involved in a fender bender and ends up in a nightclub to look for answers. Will he find the culprit and maybe, just maybe, love?

title: Capaz o incapaz?
description: Follows a thirty-something man who believes he lives in stability and harmony with his longtime girlfriend, with whom he longs to be a father. But his life takes a tremendous turn the day his house of cards falls apart.

title: Hell-O-Ween
description: After fifteen years, serial killer J.R. Hinzman has returned home for some Halloween night homicide.

title: Sam o Nargess
description: Sam and Abd and Omid are three intimate friends. Sam falls in love with sister of Abd Nargess. Then it revealed that Omid is in love with her too. Omid who is jealous goes tell Abd about Sam and Nargess. Abd who is angry goes after Sam and tries to hit him with a knife but instead hits himself and gets killed. Sam is arrested and sentenced to death but on the day of his trial the truth is revealed.

title: Quebrando o Gelo
description: Caroline, mãe solteira, terminou seu relacionamento com seu primeiro amor, Easton Black, há oito anos… Mas ela nunca lhe contou que ele a engravidou! Agora ele é a estrela de hóquei mais quente da liga e chefe de Caroline! Será que Caroline terá coragem de revelar a verdade ou será que é tarde demais? Baseado no livro Shutout de Jami Davenport!

title: Paulo, o Apóstolo
description: Follows the story of Apostle Paul.

title: O Mestre Marcial
description: Ye Tianqi vence o antigo mestre, atinge o auge marcial e destrói os meridianos de Lei Xiao. Cheio de ódio, Lei Xiao mata sua esposa e sequestra o filho. Cumprindo o último pedido da esposa, Ye sela seus meridianos e vira faxineiro, mas retorna às lutas para derrotar o Grupo Dongyang.

title: Khab o Bidar
description: Between Dreaming and Awakening, an Iranian drama series whose story revolves around gangs that sponsor the drug trade in Iran, where senior police officers confront them after they pose a real threat to the country's youth. It shows a complicated story about police trying to drag these traders into the trap, so interesting events take place in a dramatic context in which the features of the conflict between the forces of good and evil appear, and the series is a light police comic type, which gives the impression of the difficulties facing the policemen of the dangers and obstacles surrounding the policeman and his family in the same time.

title: Byomkesh O Agnibaan
description: The movie merges two stories of Sharadundu Bandopadhyay, "Agnibaan" and "Uposonghar." The film starts with the hint of another story, "Satyanweshi" where young Byomkesh catches the head of a cocaine racket who is now seeking revenge. On the other hand, a young girl dies in mysterious conditions having a match stick in her hand. One Kokonad Gupta, who claims to be a fan of Byomkesh, gifts him a matchbox.

title: O Natal Perfeito
description: Tells the story of Catarina, a rich girl who runs away from home after not receiving the desired Christmas present, and Jonas, an orphan boy who lives in a junkyard and builds his world with recycled materials.

title: Dial Red O
description: The first of the five films in which Bill Elliott plays a detective lieutenant in the L.A. Sheriff's Department, "Dial Red 0" opens with war-torn veteran Ralph Wyatt getting word that his wife is divorcing him; he flees the veterans' hospital's psychiatric ward to go talk to her. His escape touches off an all-out manhunt led by Lieutenant Andy Flynn of the Sheriff's Department. Wyatt's wife Connie is having an affair with Norman Roper, a judo expert in Wyatt's old Marine unit. When Roper refuses to divorce his own wife (Regina Gibson) to marry Connie, they have a violent quarrel in Connie's apartment. Roper kills Connie and incriminates Wyatt, who is arrested and held on suspicion of homicide. Convinced that Roper is the real murderer, Wyatt escapes from his cell in the Hollywood Sheriff's office and goes to Roper's home. Lt. Flynn has discovered evidence pointing to Roper as the killer, and arrives in time to prevent Wyatt from killing him. Jazzman Shorty Rogers and his Giants are also on hand as part of the Hollywood nightlife. Elliott's name was changed to Andy Doyle for the next four films, as a real Andy Flynn worked in Los Angeles law enforcement.

title: O Sem-Lobo Traído Virou o Rei Lycan
description: Arnaldo entrega seu lobo Alfa à amada Sabrina para realizar o sonho dela. Após ser abandonado, recebe da Deusa da Lua um poder Lycan secreto. Anos depois, a ambiciosa Sabrina invade matilhas em busca de domínio. Arnaldo precisa enfrentar seu antigo amor, combater forças das trevas e proteger novos amigos, escondendo sua verdadeira e poderosa identidade.

title: O Segredo que o Bebê Dragão Revelou
description: Após morrer em um acidente, Casey, uma renomada especialista infantil, desperta no mundo dos dragões como babá do pequeno príncipe dragão, Noah. O mais estranho é que ela consegue ouvir os pensamentos dele. Seu dom de ler mentes faz dela a única pessoa que Noah deixa chegar perto, mas também a arrasta para as rivalidades e intrigas da corte dos dragões. O frio e distante Príncipe Arthur inicialmente despreza sua origem humilde, mas sempre intervém para protegê-la. Enquanto isso, o adorável Noah ataca de cupido, aproximando os dois cada vez mais. Enquanto inimigos conspiram contra ela e as humilhações se acumulam, um romance proibido surge discretamente. Será que uma humana comum conseguirá encontrar seu lugar no reino dos dragões e conquistar o coração do príncipe?

title: We're Here S1-S4
description: A trio of drag queens descend upon various American towns and cities to inspire and teach their own "drag daughters" to step outside their comfort zone for a night of no-holds-barred full-on drag.

title: Traición y renacimiento
description: Hace siete años, Selene, mi hermana menor adoptiva y una delicada omega, atropelló a alguien estando ebria y huyó, derramando sangre en la Frontera del Territorio Humano. Mi padre alfa, mi madre luna y mi hermana biológica me hicieron la misma súplica condescendiente: Selene es una omega, es muy frágil para la prisión. Si va a la Penitenciaría Silvermoon, su loba no sobrevivirá. Lyra, toma su lugar, por favor. Me negué. Pero en una noche de tormenta, mi padre usó su mando absoluto de alfa. Destruyó mi voluntad, controló mi mente y me entregó personalmente al transporte de la prisión. Mi prometido y pareja destinada, Kaelen, el alfa más fuerte de la manada, contuvo su furiosa aura de lobo y me dijo: Lyra, cuando salgas, completaremos el vínculo. Solo resiste estos siete años.

title: La verdadera estrella y heredera

title: An Innocent Love
description: A gifted 14-year-old junior at the University of Washington replies to an ad of a 19-year-old freshman to be her maths tutor, paving the way for a friendship and a silent first crush. Will the kind genius master the lessons of the heart?

title: An Agent's Love Mistake
description: During an assignment, agent Ling Qi unexpectedly saves the richest man, Shen Yancheng, who is being hunted. The two develop feelings for each other and pledge their love. However, at that time, Shen Yancheng suffers from an eye condition and, after escaping danger, mistakenly identifies the scheming woman Zhao Chacha as Ling Qi. When Ling Qi approaches Shen Yancheng again under the guise of a marriage alliance, she believes it will be mutual love, but little does she know, it turns into a relationship full of mutual torment...

title: An Hedonia the fallen
description: The fallen angels are all that are left to save the world.

title: Living with an Expat
description: An English Expat, Kate Kensington arrives in Singapore only to find out that her living arrangement has been changed from a luxurious condo to an HDB due to budget cuts. She sets out to experience local Singaporean culture with her Singaporean flatmates Farah, Wei Ming and Raj.

title: Offside
description: Thirtysomething Suat still lives with his parents and works at his father's store when not practicing as goalie for the local football team, Esnaf Spor. The neighborhood's greatest wish is for Esnaf Spor to win the amateur league championship.

title: South at Six
description: A British News show taped from Southampton, Hampshire, England.

title: Moms at War
description: "Moms at War" is about two mothers who live in the same neighborhood, but hate each other. One felt that the other was a village girl who just got into money and is not fit to be in society with them. But both their kids coincidentally attend the same school and there was a competition that was done for the kids, and both were the top of their class. It comes down to one of them winning the competition and the mothers just go crazy, doing all sort of antics. It's a story of friendship, sisterhood, and bonding in spite of everything.

title: Doctor at Sea
description: The continuing adventures of the boys from "Doctor In The House", "Doctor At Large", and "Doctor In Charge". When Dick (Geoffrey Davies) finally gets the sack from St Swithin's, Duncan (Robin Nedwell) resigns in support. They sign up for what they hope will be a cushy job as medical officers on the cruise ship MS Begonia. Unfortunately, they didn't realise that Professor Loftus' twin brother would be the captain.

title: Dream Big at 77
description: Never to late to Dream Big. A documentary about Raul's 60 year dream to be a world champion in the decathlon.

title: Back at the Barnyard
description: A carefree cow named Otis becomes the leader of all of the animals in the barnyard.

title: The War at Home
description: Parents struggle to raise their teens.

title: Polnareff au cinéma: quand l'écran s'allume
description: Seven years after a series of memorable and sold-out live performances ("Michel Polnareff: Ze (re)tour 2007 (2007)") in his native country, French singer/songwriter/composer and US resident Michel Polnareff accepts for the first time to participate in a tell-all documentary about key moments in his life and career, as well as to provide some insights into what is going on with his long-awaited upcoming tenth studio album.

title: Voyage au pays des peaux blanches
description: Baba Camara, ten years earlier the main actor of "The Black Child", a film directed by Laurent Chevallier, is now 22 years old, and he is an apprentice mechanic in Conakry. In spring 2002, invited to accompany the film in different regions, he will discover France during this "journey to the country of white skins" where he will be an immigrant like no other: "teacher" brought to exchange with teenagers who, for the most part, have a completely abstract vision of Africa, like him will also experience his vision of France in contact with reality. "Journey to the land of white skins" is a film of discovery (of the other, of elsewhere), encounters, travels, but also a rereading of a previous film, as a tool for life and transmission.

title: Au retour des marées
description: The woman in the film returns to Beirut after many years of absence. Her return wasn't meant, she came to bury her mother. A walk at dawn leads her deep into the city which on its turn leads her to Abdallah, her past lover. But the gap of time, space and experience make this encounter impossible, or elsewhere.

title: Outlast S2

title: Let Him Be
description: Let Him Be is a fascinating film about two undergrad film students Tim Bennett & Kathleen Joyce who discover a long thought to be dead rock icon living in a remote part of Canada. It all begins when Tim discovers a clip of an old man playing guitar on a tape found jammed inside an old video camera his father gave him. The man in the video is older now but the resemblance to John Lennon is uncanny. Could it be him? It's an absurd idea and one that Tim might have pushed aside were it not for the fact that the man also sounds so much like him. Kathleen thinks the whole concept is ridiculous. Was it possible that Lennon survived the assassination? Tim decides to document the whole story so that no one could question or doubt what he finds. He has to find out if it really is him. If it is he would have to have absolute proof. That would mean convincing Kathleen to help him and it would need lots of different cameras - hidden body cameras, wireless cameras, and surveillance cameras.

title: GOL!A
description: Golia, a former rugby champion suffering from dementia, devises an ingenious escape plan to escape from the nursing home where he lives and return to his family. He will have to deal with his illness and the staff of the institution.

title: A New Mom, A New Beginning
description: After giving birth, Claire Miller plans to stay home briefly before moving into a postpartum care center. But her in-laws, Vivian Dawson and Bruce Carter, and brother-in-law Ryan Carter move in, claiming to help while doing nothing. Claire is treated like a servant, even losing the nourishing soup she made to Ryan. Her husband, Evan Carter, lets his family take her savings for his brother’s new car. Finally, Claire sees their true colors and fights back.

title: A Identidade
description: Um misterioso assassinato ocorreu na Colégio da Barra, a melhor escola de elite de São Paulo. Isto causou um enorme conflito entre três estudantes pobres que ingressaram na escola com bolsas de estudo e os filhos de famílias ricas com origens proeminentes. Além das enormes diferenças de classe, o ensino interno do colégio é cheio de conspiração e complexidade. Quem é o verdadeiro assassino deste caso?

title: A Sketch of a Rainy Day
description: The story of Ji-su who life was torn by two women in his life. One of them is his step-sister and the other is a barroom dancer named Kyung-ja.

title: It's a Drink! It's a Bomb!
description: A crooked Hong Kong cop designs a bomb disguised in a soda can and sells it to two Japanese traffickers; however, the cop's associate steals the bomb, not wishing for it to be used for evil means. He hides the bomb before he is slain by the traffickers. The incident, afterward, brought together three witnesses mixed into the plot: a suave rock scientist, a wisecracking taxi driver and an overzealous biker. They must team up to locate the missing bomb before the dealers find it.

title: Warrior S1-S3

title: Amor y sangre
description: Sophia inicia una cruzada para encontrar a su hermana gemela perdida, Tina. title: La Heredera y la Impostora

El primer día como presidenta del Grupo Shen, conoce a Vera, quien tiene una marca idéntica a la de su madre adoptiva. Dayna organiza una prueba genética. Mientras tanto, Vera finge ser Dayna y se presenta como la heredera. Así comienza una batalla entre la heredera verdadera y la impostora.
